title.zh: 鸠摩罗什在长安组织大规模译经，大乘佛教系统传入中原

summary.zh: 后秦君主姚兴尊崇佛教，迎请高僧鸠摩罗什入驻长安逍遥园和西明阁，主持规模空前的译经事业。罗什率领八百余名僧众，系统翻译了《金刚经》《法华经》《阿弥陀经》《中论》等大乘佛教重要经典，纠正了此前译经的许多错误，使大乘佛教教义首次完整、准确地传入中原，深刻影响了中国佛教各宗派的形成。

statement.zh: 后秦君主姚兴尊崇佛教，迎请高僧鸠摩罗什入驻长安逍遥园和西明阁，主持规模空前的译经事业。罗什率领八百余名僧众，系统翻译了《金刚经》《法华经》《阿弥陀经》《中论》等大乘佛教重要经典，纠正了此前译经的许多错误，使大乘佛教教义首次完整、准确地传入中原，深刻影响了中国佛教各宗派的形成。
statement.en:
Yao Xing, ruler of Later Qin, revered Buddhism and invited the eminent monk Kumarajiva to stay at Xiaoyao Garden and Ximing Pavilion in Chang'an, where he presided over an unprecedented translation project. Leading a team of over eight hundred monks, Kumarajiva systematically translated important Mahayana scriptures such as the Diamond Sutra, Lotus Sutra, Amitabha Sutra, and Middle Treatise, correcting many errors in earlier translations. This allowed Mahayana Buddhist teachings to be introduced completely and accurately into central China for the first time, profoundly influencing the formation of various Chinese Buddhist schools.

For Asia in 401 CE, “Kumarajiva organizes large-scale translation of scriptures in Chang'an, systematically introducing Mahayana Buddhism into central China” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 南凉秃发利鹿孤称王，改元建和

summary.zh: 南凉君主秃发利鹿孤在河西地区正式称王，改年号为建和。他延续兄长秃发乌孤的政策，联合后秦对抗北凉和西秦，试图巩固南凉在湟水流域的统治地位。这一政治举动加剧了河西走廊诸凉国的权力争夺。

title.zh: 西哥特王阿拉里克首次入侵意大利北部

summary.zh: 西哥特国王阿拉里克不满西罗马帝国未兑现授予他高级军职和领土的承诺，率军翻越阿尔卑斯山进入意大利北部。他攻占了阿奎莱亚等城市，威胁米兰，迫使西罗马皇帝霍诺里乌斯将首都从米兰迁往更易防守的拉文纳。这是西哥特人对意大利一系列入侵的开端。

statement.zh: 西哥特国王阿拉里克不满西罗马帝国未兑现授予他高级军职和领土的承诺，率军翻越阿尔卑斯山进入意大利北部。
statement.en: Visigothic King Alaric I, dissatisfied with the Western Roman Empire's failure to grant him a high military rank and territory, led his army across the Alps into northern Italy.

sources.locator: Paragraph on the invasion of Italy
sources.excerpt: In 401 Alaric invaded Italy, but he was defeated by the Roman general Flavius Stilicho at Pollentia (modern Pollenza) on April 6, 402, and forced to withdraw from the peninsula.

title.zh: 陶渊明辞官归隐，开创田园诗派

summary.zh: 东晋诗人陶渊明因不愿“为五斗米折腰”，辞去彭泽县令，彻底归隐田园。此后他创作了《归园田居》《饮酒》等大量诗歌，描绘自然风光和农耕生活，表达对官场的厌倦和对简朴生活的热爱，开创了中国文学史上的田园诗派，对后世文人产生了深远影响。

statement.zh: 东晋诗人陶渊明因不愿“为五斗米折腰”，辞去彭泽县令，彻底归隐田园。此后他创作了《归园田居》《饮酒》等大量诗歌，描绘自然风光和农耕生活，表达对官场的厌倦和对简朴生活的热爱，开创了中国文学史上的田园诗派，对后世文人产生了深远影响。
statement.en:
Tao Yuanming, a poet of the Eastern Jin, unwilling to 'bow for five dou of rice', resigned as magistrate of Pengze County and completely retired to his countryside. He subsequently created numerous poems such as 'Returning to Live in the Country' and 'Drinking Wine', depicting natural scenery and farming life, expressing his weariness of officialdom and love for simple living. He founded the pastoral poetry school in Chinese literary history, deeply influencing later literati.

For Asia in 401 CE, “Tao Yuanming resigns from office and retires to countryside, founding the pastoral poetry school” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马统帅斯提利科在波伦提亚战役击败阿拉里克

summary.zh: 西罗马帝国实际统治者、汪达尔裔统帅斯提利科在意大利北部波伦提亚（今意大利皮亚琴察附近）率军与西哥特国王阿拉里克决战。斯提利科利用罗马军团的纪律和战术优势，击退西哥特骑兵，迫使阿拉里克撤军。西哥特人虽然损失惨重但主力尚存，双方随后展开和谈。此战暂时保卫了意大利本土。

statement.en: Stilicho, the de facto ruler of the Western Roman Empire and a general of Vandal descent, engaged Visigothic King Alaric in a decisive battle at Pollentia (near modern Piacenza, Italy).

sources.excerpt: In 401 when Alaric and the Visigoths invaded Italy and threatened Milan, where Honorius was living, Stilicho summoned troops from the Rhine frontier and from Britain to strengthen his army, and in 402 he engaged the Goths at Pollentia (Pollenzo, near modern Bra). Alaric then marched toward Etruria, but after negotiations he agreed to withdraw from Italy.

title.zh: 西罗马帝国正式迁都拉文纳

summary.zh: 因西哥特人入侵的威胁日益严重，西罗马皇帝霍诺里乌斯在统帅斯提利科的建议下，将西罗马帝国首都从米兰正式迁往亚得里亚海沿岸的拉文纳。拉文纳四周沼泽环绕、易守难攻，且拥有优良港口，便于与东罗马帝国联系。此后拉文纳成为西罗马帝国最后七十多年的政治中心。

statement.zh: 因西哥特人入侵的威胁日益严重，西罗马皇帝霍诺里乌斯在统帅斯提利科的建议下，将西罗马帝国首都从米兰正式迁往亚得里亚海沿岸的拉文纳。
statement.en: Due to the growing threat of Visigothic invasion, Western Roman Emperor Honorius, on the advice of General Stilicho, formally moved the capital of the Western Roman Empire from Milan to Ravenna on the Adriatic coast.

en: Due to the growing threat of Visigothic invasion, Western Roman Emperor Honorius, on the advice of General Stilicho, formally moved the capital of the Western Roman Empire from Milan to Ravenna on the Adriatic coast.

title.zh: 基督教修道制度在罗马帝国东部蓬勃发展

summary.zh: 在圣帕科米乌斯和圣巴西勒等教父的影响下，集体隐修（公社式修道）制度在东罗马帝国的小亚细亚、叙利亚和埃及地区迅速传播。修道院成为学习和慈善的中心，吸引了大批信徒抛弃世俗生活。这一运动奠定了西方基督教修道制度的基础，本尼迪克特修道规则也在此背景下逐渐成型。

statement.en: Under the influence of Church Fathers such as Saint Pachomius and Saint Basil, communal monasticism spread rapidly in Asia Minor, Syria, and Egypt within the Eastern Roman Empire.

title.zh: 桓玄攻入建康，总揽朝政

summary.zh: 东晋荆州刺史桓玄利用朝廷内部矛盾，率军沿长江东下，攻入东晋都城建康（今南京）。他杀害了执政的司马道子、司马元显父子，控制了东晋朝廷，自封为丞相、太尉、扬州牧，总揽军政大权。桓玄的专权为次年篡晋称帝铺平了道路，也使东晋的中央权威进一步瓦解。

title.zh: 西哥特国王阿拉里克颁布《西哥特罗马法典》

summary.zh: 为了有效统治罗马境内的西哥特人和罗马臣民，西哥特国王阿拉里克在罗马法学家协助下，颁布了《西哥特罗马法典》（Breviarium Alaricianum）。该法典主要改编自罗马《狄奥多西法典》，并加入了西哥特人的传统习惯法，成为西哥特王国最早的成文法典，对中世纪欧洲法律发展产生了重要影响。

statement.en: To effectively rule both the Visigoths and Roman subjects within Roman territory, Visigothic King Alaric I, with the assistance of Roman jurists, issued the Breviary of Alaric (Breviarium Alaricianum).

title.zh: 孙恩起义失败，投海自尽

summary.zh: 东晋五斗米道领袖孙恩领导的海上起义军在临海一带遭到东晋北府兵将领刘裕的连续打击，军队损失惨重，主力溃散。孙恩走投无路，与其部属数百人一起投海自尽。孙恩起义持续三年，波及会稽、吴郡等八郡，沉重打击了东晋门阀士族的统治，也为刘裕的崛起提供了军事和政治资本。

statement.zh: 东晋五斗米道领袖孙恩领导的海上起义军在临海一带遭到东晋北府兵将领刘裕的连续打击，军队损失惨重，主力溃散。孙恩走投无路，与其部属数百人一起投海自尽。孙恩起义持续三年，波及会稽、吴郡等八郡，沉重打击了东晋门阀士族的统治，也为刘裕的崛起提供了军事和政治资本。
statement.en:
Sun En, leader of the Way of the Five Pecks of Rice rebellion in Eastern Jin, suffered continuous defeats from Liu Yu, a general of the Northern Army, near Linhai. His forces were devastated, and with nowhere to turn, Sun En drowned himself along with several 100 followers. The rebellion had lasted three years, affecting eight commanderies including Kuaiji and Wu, severely weakening the rule of the aristocratic clans and providing Liu Yu with military and political capital for his rise.

For Asia in 402 CE, “Sun En's rebellion fails, he drowns himself” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 法显抵达天竺，在佛教圣地进行巡礼

summary.zh: 中国东晋高僧法显历经沙漠和雪山的艰险，抵达天竺（今印度）境内。他先后巡礼了拘萨罗国舍卫城、迦毗罗卫城、菩提伽耶、鹿野苑等佛教圣地，并在摩揭陀国华氏城的大乘寺庙学习梵文和佛教经典。法显此行带回了大量戒律经典，是中国第一位成功从陆路赴天竺并取经归国的僧人。

title.zh: 罗马统帅斯提利科在维罗纳再次击败阿拉里克

summary.zh: 西哥特国王阿拉里克再次率军入侵意大利北部，罗马统帅斯提利科在维罗纳附近与其交战。斯提利科利用地形优势和精锐的罗马骑兵击败西哥特军队，阿拉里克被迫放弃进攻拉文纳的计划，率残部撤出意大利。这是斯提利科对西哥特人的第二次重大胜利，暂时稳住了西罗马帝国的局势。

statement.zh: 西哥特国王阿拉里克再次率军入侵意大利北部，罗马统帅斯提利科在维罗纳附近与其交战。斯提利科利用地形优势和精锐的罗马骑兵击败西哥特军队，阿拉里克被迫放弃进攻拉文纳的计划，率残部撤出意大利。这是斯提利科对西哥特人的第二次重大胜利，暂时稳住了西罗马帝国的局势。
statement.en:
Visigothic King Alaric again invaded northern Italy, and Roman general Stilicho engaged him near Verona. Using terrain advantages and elite Roman cavalry, Stilicho defeated the Visigothic army. Alaric was forced to abandon his plan to attack Ravenna and withdrew his remaining forces from Italy. title.zh: 鸠摩罗什译出《大智度论》

summary.zh: 后秦高僧鸠摩罗什在长安译出《大智度论》，这是一部对《大品般若经》的详细注释，共一百卷，系统阐述了中观学派的核心思想。该论典的译出极大地推动了中国佛教般若学的发展，成为三论宗和天台宗的重要理论依据。

statement.zh: 后秦高僧鸠摩罗什在长安译出《大智度论》，这是一部对《大品般若经》的详细注释，共一百卷，系统阐述了中观学派的核心思想。该论典的译出极大地推动了中国佛教般若学的发展，成为三论宗和天台宗的重要理论依据。
statement.en:
In 404, the Later Qin eminent monk Kumarajiva translated the Great Perfection of Wisdom Treatise (Mahaprajnaparamita Shastra) in Chang'an. This work, a detailed commentary on the Large Perfection of Wisdom Sutra in one hundred rolls, systematically expounded the core ideas of the Madhyamaka school. Its translation greatly promoted the development of Prajna studies in Chinese Buddhism and became an important theoretical basis for the Sanlun and Tiantai schools.

For Asia in 404 CE, “Kumarajiva translates the Great Perfection of Wisdom Treatise” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 桓玄在江陵兵败被杀

summary.zh: 桓玄挟持晋安帝逃往江陵（今湖北荆州）后，试图重整军队。刘裕派部下追击，桓玄在江陵城外的战斗中再次大败，在逃亡途中被益州督护冯迁斩杀。刘裕迎晋安帝回建康复位，彻底平定桓玄之乱，东晋皇室名存实亡，大权完全落入刘裕手中。

statement.zh: 桓玄挟持晋安帝逃往江陵（今湖北荆州）后，试图重整军队。刘裕派部下追击，桓玄在江陵城外的战斗中再次大败，在逃亡途中被益州督护冯迁斩杀。刘裕迎晋安帝回建康复位，彻底平定桓玄之乱，东晋皇室名存实亡，大权完全落入刘裕手中。
statement.en:
After fleeing to Jiangling (modern Jingzhou, Hubei) with Emperor An, Huan Xuan attempted to regroup. Liu Yu sent his subordinates in pursuit. Huan Xuan was again decisively defeated in battle outside Jiangling and was killed by Feng Qian, a protector of Yizhou, while fleeing. Liu Yu welcomed Emperor An back to Jiankang to restore his position, completely quelling the Huan Xuan rebellion. The Eastern Jin imperial house lost all real power, which fell entirely into Liu Yu's hands.

For Asia in 404 CE, “Huan Xuan defeated and killed at Jiangling” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 北魏皇帝拓跋珪推行离散诸部政策

summary.zh: 北魏道武帝拓跋珪为了加强中央集权，推行“离散诸部”政策，强制将各部落的人口拆散，编入由皇帝直接控制的“国人”系统和州县体系。这一政策削弱了鲜卑贵族的部族势力，使北魏从部落联盟向封建集权国家转型，但也引发了部分部落首领的反抗。

title.zh: 耶柔米完成《武加大译本》

summary.zh: 学者耶柔米（哲罗姆）将圣经译为拉丁文《武加大译本》，成为中世纪西欧教会标准文本。

statement.zh: 学者耶柔米（哲罗姆）将圣经译为拉丁文《武加大译本》，成为中世纪西欧教会标准文本。他从希伯来文与希腊文校订旧译，力求在拉丁语的表达与原文之间取得平衡；译本的语言后来深刻塑造了西欧的宗教词汇与文学风格。“武加大”意为通行本，其地位在长期使用与礼仪实践中确立，而非一次颁布。
statement.en: The scholar Jerome (Jerome) translated the Bible into the Latin "Vulgate", which became the standard text of the Western European church in the Middle Ages.

title.zh: 晋安帝复位，刘裕掌控东晋朝政

summary.zh: 刘裕平定桓玄之乱后，迎晋安帝司马德宗返回建康复位，改元义熙。刘裕自任侍中、车骑将军、都督中外诸军事，掌控了东晋的军政大权。他大量起用北府兵旧部和中下层士人，开始整顿内政、削弱门阀势力，为其后北伐奠定了基础。

title.zh: 不列颠驻军推举君士坦丁三世为帝

summary.zh: 因担心蛮族入侵不列颠，驻守不列颠的罗马军队推举普通士兵君士坦丁为帝，史称君士坦丁三世。他随即率军渡海进入高卢，在高卢和西班牙建立了自己的统治，与西罗马皇帝霍诺里乌斯分庭抗礼。君士坦丁三世的僭位进一步削弱了西罗马帝国对西部行省的控制。

statement.en: Fearing barbarian invasion of Britain, the Roman garrison there proclaimed a common soldier, Constantine, as emperor (known as Constantine III).

title.zh: 汪达尔、苏维汇和阿兰人越过莱茵河，入侵高卢

summary.zh: 在匈奴西迁的压力推动下，汪达尔人、苏维汇人和阿兰人联合行动，于公元406年12月31日越过冰封的莱茵河，大举入侵西罗马帝国的高卢行省。蛮族军队洗劫了美因茨、特里尔等城市，高卢的罗马防御体系彻底崩溃。这是继公元前390年高卢人入侵后最大规模的外族入侵，标志着西罗马帝国对莱茵河边境控制的彻底终结。

statement.zh: 在匈奴西迁的压力推动下，汪达尔人、苏维汇人和阿兰人联合行动，于公元406年12月31日越过冰封的莱茵河，大举入侵西罗马帝国的高卢行省。
statement.en: Driven by Hun pressure from the east, the Vandals, Suebi, and Alans jointly crossed the frozen Rhine on December 31, 406, and poured into the Western Roman province of Gaul.

sources.excerpt: In 406–407 Germanic and other tribes (Vandals, Alani, Suebi, and Burgundians) from Silesia and even farther east crossed the Rhine in their flight from the Huns and penetrated as far as Spain.

title.zh: 刘裕实行土断，整顿户籍与赋税

summary.zh: 东晋执政刘裕在全国范围内推行“义熙土断”，废除侨州郡县，将南渡北方侨民编入本地户籍，统一征收赋税。这一措施打击了隐匿户籍的世家大族，增加了朝廷财政收入，同时缓解了南北民众之间的矛盾，为刘裕北伐积蓄了经济力量。

statement.zh: 东晋执政刘裕在全国范围内推行“义熙土断”，废除侨州郡县，将南渡北方侨民编入本地户籍，统一征收赋税。
statement.en: The Eastern Jin regent Liu Yu carried out a nationwide 'Yixi Tunduan' (land and household registration reform), abolishing émigré commanderies and prefectures, registering southern refugee families into local rolls, and levying taxes uniformly.

zh: 东晋执政刘裕在全国范围内推行“义熙土断”，废除侨州郡县，将南渡北方侨民编入本地户籍，统一征收赋税。
en: The Eastern Jin regent Liu Yu carried out a nationwide 'Yixi Tunduan' (land and household registration reform), abolishing émigré commanderies and prefectures, registering southern refugee families into local rolls, and levying taxes uniformly.

statement.en: This measure struck at the aristocratic clans who had hidden households, increased state revenue, and eased tensions between northern and southern commoners, accumulating economic strength for Liu Yu's northern expeditions.

title.zh: 赫连勃勃自称大夏天王，建立大夏政权

summary.zh: 匈奴铁弗部首领赫连勃勃自称大夏天王、大单于，建立大夏政权。他依托统万城（今陕西靖边）为核心，采取游击战术骚扰后秦边境，先后击败南凉、后秦等势力，逐渐控制河套和陕北地区。赫连勃勃以残暴著称，所过之处寸草不留，但也筑造了极其坚固的统万城作为都城。

title.zh: 西罗马皇帝霍诺里乌斯下令从大不列颠撤军

summary.zh: 西罗马帝国因应付高卢和意大利的蛮族入侵，兵力严重不足，皇帝霍诺里乌斯下令从大不列颠撤出最后一支罗马野战军，以保卫意大利本土。驻军撤离后，不列颠的罗马化城市失去保护，陆续遭到皮克特人、苏格兰人和盎格鲁-撒克逊人的袭击，罗马文明在不列颠迅速衰落。

statement.zh: 西罗马帝国因应付高卢和意大利的蛮族入侵，兵力严重不足，皇帝霍诺里乌斯下令从大不列颠撤出最后一支罗马野战军，以保卫意大利本土。驻军撤离后，不列颠的罗马化城市失去保护，陆续遭到皮克特人、苏格兰人和盎格鲁-撒克逊人的袭击，罗马文明在不列颠迅速衰落。
statement.en:
Unable to handle barbarian invasions in Gaul and Italy, Western Roman Emperor Honorius ordered the last Roman field army in Britain to withdraw to defend Italy. After the garrison left, the Romanized cities of Britain lost military protection and came under increasing attacks by Picts, Scots, and Anglo-Saxons. Roman civilization in Britain rapidly declined.

For Europe in 407 CE, “Western Roman Emperor Honorius orders withdrawal from Britain” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 西罗马皇帝霍诺里乌斯处死统帅斯提利科

summary.zh: 西罗马帝国爆发宫廷阴谋，大臣奥林庇乌斯诬陷统帅斯提利科密谋让其子篡位，并与西哥特国王阿拉里克暗中勾结。偏信谗言的皇帝霍诺里乌斯下令处死斯提利科及其支持者，许多效忠于斯提利科的蛮族士兵遭到屠杀。这一愚蠢的决策导致西罗马失去最优秀的军事统帅，大量蛮族士兵叛逃到阿拉里克阵营，罗马军队的实力急剧削弱。

title.zh: 法显抵达狮子国并停留两年学习佛法

summary.zh: 东晋高僧法显从印度乘船抵达狮子国（今斯里兰卡），这里是佛教上座部的重要中心。法显在该国住了两年，学习律藏和经藏，并抄写了《弥沙塞律》《长阿含经》等典籍，亲眼目睹了当地盛大的佛牙节庆典。斯里兰卡之行补充了他在印度未能获得的佛教文献。

statement.zh: 东晋高僧法显从印度乘船抵达狮子国（今斯里兰卡），这里是佛教上座部的重要中心。法显在该国住了两年，学习律藏和经藏，并抄写了《弥沙塞律》《长阿含经》等典籍，亲眼目睹了当地盛大的佛牙节庆典。斯里兰卡之行补充了他在印度未能获得的佛教文献。
statement.en:
The Eastern Jin monk Faxian arrived by ship from India in Sri Lanka (then called the Lion Kingdom), an important center of Theravada Buddhism. He stayed there for two years, studying the Vinaya and Sutra Pitakas, and copied scriptures including the Mahisasaka Vinaya and the Dirgha Agama. He witnessed the grand tooth relic festival. His stay in Sri Lanka supplemented Buddhist texts he had not been able to obtain in India.

In 408 CE, “Faxian arrives in Sri Lanka and stays two years to study Buddhism” belongs to the field of Religion in Asia.

title.zh: 汪达尔人、阿兰人和苏维汇人从高卢进入西班牙

summary.zh: 在连续劫掠高卢三年后，汪达尔人、阿兰人和苏维汇人联合越过比利牛斯山脉，进入西罗马帝国的西班牙行省。他们迅速占领了除迦太基纳之外的伊比利亚半岛大部分地区，罗马帝国在西班牙的统治名存实亡。这些蛮族在西班牙分别定居，为后来西哥特人征服西班牙埋下了伏笔。

title.zh: 卢循、徐道覆率起义军北上，逼近建康

summary.zh: 孙恩起义的余部卢循和徐道覆在广州和始兴重新聚集起义军，兵分两路沿长江东下。起义军号称十万，水陆并进，接连攻占长沙、江陵等重镇，前锋进抵建康附近的秦淮河口。建康城内人心惶惶，东晋朝廷陷入危机。刘裕率北伐军主力火速回师防守建康。

title.zh: 法显从狮子国乘船东归，到达耶婆提国

summary.zh: 东晋高僧法显结束在狮子国（今斯里兰卡）的学习，搭乘一艘载有二百余人的大商船启程东归，船上携带了大量佛经和佛像。航行途中遭遇风暴，船只偏离航线，漂流了九十余天后到达耶婆提国（一般认为在今印度尼西亚的爪哇岛或苏门答腊岛）。法显在此停留五个月，等待季风继续航行回国。

statement.en: In 410, after completing his studies in Sri Lanka, the Eastern Jin monk Faxian boarded a large merchant vessel carrying over two hundred people to return east, laden with many scriptures and Buddhist images.

title.zh: 阿拉里克劫掠罗马：象征性重击，不是帝国终点

summary.zh: 402年，西罗马迁都拉文纳；408、409、410年阿拉里克三次围攻罗马。410年8月24日夜，身份不明者打开城门，西哥特军入城劫掠三天，但尊重普通居民、只破坏少数公共建筑。这是近800年来罗马第一次被外敌攻陷；阿拉里克随后病死，西哥特人前往西班牙。

statement.zh: 402年，西罗马把首都从罗马迁到更易防守的拉文纳；408、409、410年，阿拉里克三次围攻罗马。
statement.en: In 402 the Western Roman capital moved from Rome to the more defensible Ravenna; Alaric besieged Rome in 408, 409 and 410.

sources.excerpt: For years he waged war on the Eastern Roman Empire; yet the Western Empire feared the Visigoths’ anger, so much so that in 402 the Romans moved their capital from Rome to the more readily defensible city of Ravenna, in northeastern Italy.

Although Alaric was eager for peace, the Western emperor Flavius Honorius refused to recognize his requests for land and supplies. The Visigothic chieftain thereupon laid siege to Rome (408) until the Senate granted him another subsidy and assistance in his negotiations with Honorius. Honorius remained intransigent, however, and in 409 Alaric again surrounded Rome.

zh: 402年，西罗马把首都从罗马迁到更易防守的拉文纳；408、409、410年，阿拉里克三次围攻罗马。
en: In 402 the Western Roman capital moved from Rome to the more defensible Ravenna; Alaric besieged Rome in 408, 409 and 410.

note.en: 402 capital move and three sieges follow the entries.

statement.zh: 410年8月24日夜，身份不明的人打开城门；西哥特军队入城，进行了三天劫掠，抢劫国库与皇宫，但尊重普通罗马居民，只破坏少数公共建筑。
statement.en: On the night of August 24, 410, unknown persons opened the gates; the Visigoths entered and plundered for three days, raiding the treasury and imperial palaces, but respecting ordinary Roman inhabitants and destroying only a handful of public buildings.

sources.excerpt: On the night of August 24, 410, some unknown person or persons quietly opened the gates of Rome to admit the Visigoths. Exacting vengeance for Honorius’s slight, as well as the money they were owed, they embarked on a three-day spree of plunder, raiding the treasury and imperial palaces. Throughout, Alaric and his forces, Christians all, were respectful of ordinary Roman citizens and confined destruction to a handful of public buildings.

Negotiations with Honorius broke down, and Alaric deposed Attalus in the summer of 410, besieging Rome for the third time. Allies within the capital opened the gates for him on August 24, and for three days his troops occupied the city, which had not been captured by a foreign enemy for nearly 800 years. Although the Visigoths plundered Rome, they treated its inhabitants humanely and burned only a few buildings.

zh: 410年8月24日夜，身份不明的人打开城门；西哥特军队入城，进行了三天劫掠，抢劫国库与皇宫，但尊重普通罗马居民，只破坏少数公共建筑。
en: On the night of August 24, 410, unknown persons opened the gates; the Visigoths entered and plundered for three days, raiding the treasury and imperial palaces, but respecting ordinary Roman inhabitants and destroying only a handful of public buildings.

note.zh: 写“身份不明者开门”，不写“蛮族奴隶打开萨拉里亚门”。
note.en: Says unknown persons opened the gates, not 'barbarian slaves opened the Salarian Gate'.

statement.zh: 这是近800年来罗马第一次被外敌攻陷。
statement.en: It was the first time in nearly 800 years that Rome had been captured by a foreign enemy.

sources.excerpt: Negotiations with Honorius broke down, and Alaric deposed Attalus in the summer of 410, besieging Rome for the third time. Allies within the capital opened the gates for him on August 24, and for three days his troops occupied the city, which had not been captured by a foreign enemy for nearly 800 years. Although the Visigoths plundered Rome, they treated its inhabitants humanely and burned only a few buildings.

zh: 这是近800年来罗马第一次被外敌攻陷。
en: It was the first time in nearly 800 years that Rome had been captured by a foreign enemy.

note.zh: “近800年”照条目，不写精确 800。
note.en: 'Nearly 800 years' follows the entry; no exact 800.

statement.zh: 阿拉里克在劫掠后南下，计划进攻北非，却在卡拉布里亚病死；西哥特人随后前往西班牙定居。
statement.en: After the sack Alaric marched south, planning to attack North Africa, but died of illness in Calabria; the Visigoths then moved on to Spain.

sources.excerpt: Having abandoned a plan to occupy Africa, Alaric died as the Visigoths were marching northward.

On the night of August 24, 410, some unknown person or persons quietly opened the gates of Rome to admit the Visigoths. Exacting vengeance for Honorius’s slight, as well as the money they were owed, they embarked on a three-day spree of plunder, raiding the treasury and imperial palaces. Throughout, Alaric and his forces, Christians all, were respectful of ordinary Roman citizens and confined destruction to a handful of public buildings.

zh: 阿拉里克在劫掠后南下，计划进攻北非，却在卡拉布里亚病死；西哥特人随后前往西班牙定居。
en: After the sack Alaric marched south, planning to attack North Africa, but died of illness in Calabria; the Visigoths then moved on to Spain.

note.zh: 病死与前往西班牙照条目；不写“建立西哥特王国”细节。
note.en: Death and move to Spain follow the entries; no kingdom-founding detail.

statement.zh: 奥古斯丁在413年开始写《上帝之城》，把罗马之劫解释为世俗权力的道德衰败；这更多是神学回应，不是军事报告。
statement.en: Augustine began City of God in 413, treating the sack as a sign of the moral decay of earthly power; this was a theological response, not a military report.

sources.excerpt: Much of the symbolic significance of the Sack of Rome owes to Augustine of Hippo, whose City of God, begun in 413, treats it as a sign of the moral decay wrought by earthly power.

zh: 奥古斯丁在413年开始写《上帝之城》，把罗马之劫解释为世俗权力的道德衰败；这更多是神学回应，不是军事报告。
en: Augustine began City of God in 413, treating the sack as a sign of the moral decay of earthly power; this was a theological response, not a military report.

note.zh: 标明是神学解释，不当作事件记录。
note.en: Flagged as theology, not an event record.

statement.zh: 410年是一次象征性的重击，不是帝国灭亡的日期；“罗马衰亡”是长期过程，军事、财政、政治与宗教因素都在其中。
statement.en: 410 was a symbolic blow, not the date of the empire's fall; 'the fall of Rome' was a long process involving military, fiscal, political and religious factors.

zh: 410年是一次象征性的重击，不是帝国灭亡的日期；“罗马衰亡”是长期过程，军事、财政、政治与宗教因素都在其中。
en: 410 was a symbolic blow, not the date of the empire's fall; 'the fall of Rome' was a long process involving military, fiscal, political and religious factors.

note.zh: 作者判断：拒绝把 410 当作帝国终点。
note.en: Author judgment: rejects 410 as the empire's endpoint.

title.zh: 刘裕攻克广固，灭亡南燕

summary.zh: 东晋太尉刘裕率军围攻南燕都城广固城（今山东青州）。南燕皇帝慕容超拒绝投降，晋军采用挖地道、抛石机和火攻等多种战术，经过长达八个月的围攻，终于攻破广固。刘裕下令屠城，将慕容超押回建康斩首，南燕灭亡。刘裕北伐胜利后，收复了山东和淮北地区，威望达到顶峰。

statement.zh: 东晋太尉刘裕率军围攻南燕都城广固城（今山东青州）。南燕皇帝慕容超拒绝投降，晋军采用挖地道、抛石机和火攻等多种战术，经过长达八个月的围攻，终于攻破广固。刘裕下令屠城，将慕容超押回建康斩首，南燕灭亡。刘裕北伐胜利后，收复了山东和淮北地区，威望达到顶峰。
statement.en:
Liu Yu, Grand Commandant of Eastern Jin, besieged the Southern Yan capital Guanggu (modern Qingzhou, Shandong). Southern Yan emperor Murong Chao refused to surrender. The Jin army used tunneling, trebuchets, and fire attacks, and after eight months finally breached the city. Liu Yu ordered a massacre. Murong Chao was taken back to Jiankang and beheaded, ending Southern Yan. With this victory, Liu Yu recovered Shandong and the Huaihei region, and his prestige reached its peak.

For Asia in 410 CE, “Liu Yu captures Guanggu, destroys Southern Yan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

The Jin army used tunneling, trebuchets, and fire attacks, and after eight months finally breached the city. Liu Yu ordered a massacre. Murong Chao was taken back to Jiankang and beheaded, ending Southern Yan. With this victory, Liu Yu recovered Shandong and the Huaihei region, and his prestige reached its peak.

title.zh: 西哥特人阿陶尔夫继位，率军退往高卢南部

title.zh: 卢循在广州被晋军剿灭，投水自尽

summary.zh: 东晋将领杜慧度率军攻入起义军最后据点广州。卢循组织残余兵力抵抗，但终因寡不敌众而失败。卢循走投无路，与孙恩一样投水自尽。持续十三年的孙恩、卢循起义至此彻底结束，起义沉重打击了东晋门阀士族的统治基础，加速了刘裕取代东晋的进程。

statement.zh: 东晋将领杜慧度率军攻入起义军最后据点广州。卢循组织残余兵力抵抗，但终因寡不敌众而失败。卢循走投无路，与孙恩一样投水自尽。持续十三年的孙恩、卢循起义至此彻底结束，起义沉重打击了东晋门阀士族的统治基础，加速了刘裕取代东晋的进程。
statement.en:
The Eastern Jin general Du Huidu led forces into the rebels' last stronghold, Guangzhou. Lu Xun organized a desperate resistance but was outnumbered. With no way out, Lu Xun followed Sun En's example and drowned himself. The thirteen-year-long Sun En and Lu Xun rebellion thus ended completely. The rebellion had severely damaged the rule of the Eastern Jin aristocratic clans and accelerated Liu Yu's eventual replacement of the Jin dynasty.

For Asia in 411 CE, “Lu Xun is defeated and drowns himself in Guangzhou” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 法显携带大量佛经从海路返回中国

summary.zh: 东晋高僧法显在耶婆提国休整数月后，再次搭乘商船启程。航行途中再次遭遇风暴，船只辗转到达青州长广郡牢山（今山东青岛崂山）附近登陆。法显此行历时十三年，游历三十余国，带回梵文佛经十一部，包括《摩诃僧祇律》《方等泥洹经》等重要典籍，为中国佛教戒律的完善做出了不可替代的贡献。

statement.zh: 东晋高僧法显在耶婆提国休整数月后，再次搭乘商船启程。航行途中再次遭遇风暴，船只辗转到达青州长广郡牢山（今山东青岛崂山）附近登陆。法显此行历时十三年，游历三十余国，带回梵文佛经十一部，包括《摩诃僧祇律》《方等泥洹经》等重要典籍，为中国佛教戒律的完善做出了不可替代的贡献。
statement.en:
After resting several months in Yavadvipa, the Eastern Jin monk Faxian again boarded a merchant ship. Another storm hit, and the ship eventually landed near Laoshan in Changguang Commandery, Qingzhou (modern Qingdao, Shandong). Faxian's journey had lasted thirteen years, covering over thirty countries. He brought back eleven Sanskrit Buddhist texts, including the Mahasanghika Vinaya and the Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra, making an irreplaceable contribution to the development of Buddhist precepts in China.

For Asia in 412 CE, “Faxian returns to China by sea with many Buddhist scriptures” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 女哲学家希帕提娅在亚历山大城被暴徒杀害

summary.zh: 亚历山大城著名的女哲学家、数学家、天文学家希帕提娅，因其在科学和哲学领域的影响力，被视为世俗学术的象征。亚历山大城主教西里尔的支持者指责她蛊惑罗马总督拒绝与主教和解，一群暴徒将她从马车上拖下，用陶片剥去皮肤，然后将尸块焚烧。这一事件标志着古典学术与基督教极端势力冲突的激化，许多学者因此离开了亚历山大城。

statement.zh: 亚历山大城著名的女哲学家、数学家、天文学家希帕提娅，因其在科学和哲学领域的影响力，被视为世俗学术的象征。亚历山大城主教西里尔的支持者指责她蛊惑罗马总督拒绝与主教和解，一群暴徒将她从马车上拖下，用陶片剥去皮肤，然后将尸块焚烧。这一事件标志着古典学术与基督教极端势力冲突的激化，许多学者因此离开了亚历山大城。
statement.en:
Hypatia, the renowned female philosopher, mathematician, and astronomer of Alexandria, was seen as a symbol of secular learning due to her influence. Supporters of Bishop Cyril of Alexandria accused her of persuading the Roman prefect to refuse reconciliation with the bishop. A mob dragged her from her carriage, skinned her with pottery shards, and burned her remains. This event marked an escalation of conflict between classical scholarship and radical Christian forces, leading many scholars to leave Alexandria.

For Africa in 412 CE, “Female philosopher Hypatia murdered by a mob in Alexandria” is a traceable node of Society change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 赫连勃勃开始修筑统万城

summary.zh: 大夏国王赫连勃勃征发十万民夫和工匠，在今陕西靖边县北部的沙漠边缘修筑都城统万城。城墙使用蒸土夯筑工艺，异常坚固，相传铁锥扎入一寸即斩造城工匠。统万城是十六国时期规模最大、最坚固的都城之一，象征大夏政权的军事化特质和赫连勃勃的暴虐统治。

statement.zh: 大夏国王赫连勃勃征发十万民夫和工匠，在今陕西靖边县北部的沙漠边缘修筑都城统万城。
statement.en: Helian Bobo, king of Great Xia, conscripted 100,000 laborers and craftsmen to build his capital, Tongwan City, on the edge of the desert in modern Jingbian County, Shaanxi.

title.zh: 狄奥多西城墙：把君士坦丁堡围成要塞

summary.zh: 413年，狄奥多西二世在位时修筑内墙；447年加建外墙。陆墙约7公里长，内墙约9米高、5米厚，前有壕沟；1453年才被奥斯曼火炮突破。

statement.zh: 413年，狄奥多西二世在位时，君士坦丁堡的陆墙内墙开始修筑；447年，外墙加建。前方还有一条壕沟。
statement.en: In 413, during the reign of Theodosius II, the inner land wall of Constantinople was begun; in 447 the outer wall was added. A moat ran in front.

sources.excerpt: The walls are 4.5 miles (7 km) long and consist of a double line of ramparts—the inner built in 413, the outer in 447—protected by a moat.

zh: 413年，狄奥多西二世在位时，君士坦丁堡的陆墙内墙开始修筑；447年，外墙加建。前方还有一条壕沟。
en: In 413, during the reign of Theodosius II, the inner land wall of Constantinople was begun; in 447 the outer wall was added. A moat ran in front.

note.zh: 413 内墙、447 外墙、壕沟均取自上列原文。
note.en: Inner wall 413, outer 447 and moat are all in the excerpt.

statement.zh: 两道城墙沿半岛西端展开，把城市与内陆隔开。
statement.en: The two lines ran across the western end of the peninsula, separating the city from the mainland.

sources.excerpt: The land walls, which isolate the peninsula from the mainland, were breached only once, by cannon of the Ottoman sultan Mehmed II (the Conqueror) in 1453, at the spot since called Cannon Gate (Top Kapısı).

zh: 两道城墙沿半岛西端展开，把城市与内陆隔开。
en: The two lines ran across the western end of the peninsula, separating the city from the mainland.

note.zh: “沿半岛西端”是地形描述；原文只明确说陆墙把半岛与内陆隔开。
note.en: 'Western end' is a topographic description; the excerpt states the walls isolate the peninsula from the mainland.

statement.zh: 陆墙全长约7公里。内墙约9米高、5米厚，塔楼约18米高，彼此相距约55米。
statement.en: The land walls were about 7 km long. The inner wall was about 9 metres high and 5 metres thick; its towers were about 18 metres high and roughly 55 metres apart.

sources.excerpt: The walls are 4.5 miles (7 km) long and consist of a double line of ramparts—the inner built in 413, the outer in 447—protected by a moat. The higher inner wall is about 30 feet (9 metres) high and 16 feet (5 metres) thick and is studded with 60-foot (18-metre) towers about 180 feet (55 metres) apart.

zh: 陆墙全长约7公里。内墙约9米高、5米厚，塔楼约18米高，彼此相距约55米。
en: The land walls were about 7 km long. The inner wall was about 9 metres high and 5 metres thick; its towers were about 18 metres high and roughly 55 metres apart.

note.zh: 数字全部按原文，不再使用旧稿的12米、5.6公里。
note.en: All figures follow the excerpt; the old 12 m and 5.6 km are dropped.

statement.zh: 外墙原有92座塔楼，今天仍存56座。
statement.en: The outer wall originally had 92 towers, of which 56 still stand.

zh: 外墙原有92座塔楼，今天仍存56座。
en: The outer wall originally had 92 towers, of which 56 still stand.

note.zh: 原文用 turrets；正文用“塔楼”。
note.en: The excerpt says turrets; the body uses towers.

statement.zh: 这套防线在1453年才被奥斯曼苏丹穆罕默德二世的火炮突破；此前陆路围攻没有攻破它。
statement.en: The line was breached only in 1453, by the cannon of the Ottoman sultan Mehmed II; earlier land sieges failed to break it.

sources.excerpt: The land walls, which isolate the peninsula from the mainland, were breached only once, by cannon of the Ottoman sultan Mehmed II (the Conqueror) in 1453, at the spot since called Cannon Gate (Top Kapısı).

en: The line was breached only in 1453, by the cannon of the Ottoman sultan Mehmed II; earlier land sieges failed to break it.

note.zh: “此前陆路围攻没有攻破”是对 breached only once 的直接转述。
note.en: 'Earlier land sieges failed' restates 'breached only once'.

statement.zh: 但城墙不是自动生效的保险。守军、粮食、维修和海上补给缺一不可；它把资源固定在首都，也把帝国的命运压在一座城上。
statement.en: But walls do not guarantee safety by themselves. They need soldiers, grain, repairs and sea supply; they fix resources at the capital and tie the empire's fate to one city.

title.zh: 西哥特王国与西罗马帝国签订正式同盟条约

summary.zh: 西哥特国王瓦利亚（继阿陶尔夫后）与西罗马帝国皇帝霍诺里乌斯签订条约。西哥特人作为罗马的同盟者（联邦者）定居在高卢西南部的阿基坦行省，从图卢兹到波尔多一带。西哥特人承诺为罗马帝国提供军队，打击其他蛮族，尤其是汪达尔人和阿兰人。条约使西哥特王国获得了合法地位，也为西罗马帝国利用蛮族对抗蛮族的策略提供了范例。

statement.zh: 西哥特国王瓦利亚（继阿陶尔夫后）与西罗马帝国皇帝霍诺里乌斯签订条约。
statement.en: Visigothic king Wallia (who succeeded Athaulf) signed a treaty with Western Roman Emperor Honorius.

sources.excerpt: Wallia was a Visigothic king who ruled from 415 to 418 CE. He succeeded Athaulf and, under his leadership, the Visigoths were recognized as allies of the Roman Empire. The Romans encouraged Wallia to campaign against other barbarian tribes in the Iberian Peninsula. Following these campaigns, the Visigoths were authorized by the Roman emperor Honorius to settle in the Roman provinces of Aquitania Secunda and Narbonensis in Gaul.

title.zh: 后秦皇帝姚兴大举进攻大夏，兵败退回

summary.zh: 后秦皇帝姚兴亲自率军进攻赫连勃勃的大夏政权，试图收复陕北失地。赫连勃勃采用坚壁清野、诱敌深入的战术，后秦军队在沙漠中补给困难，士气低落，被迫撤退。大夏骑兵趁机追击，后秦军损失惨重。此战后秦的国力进一步衰落，大夏在河套地区更加稳固。

statement.zh: 后秦皇帝姚兴亲自率军进攻赫连勃勃的大夏政权，试图收复陕北失地。赫连勃勃采用坚壁清野、诱敌深入的战术，后秦军队在沙漠中补给困难，士气低落，被迫撤退。大夏骑兵趁机追击，后秦军损失惨重。此战后秦的国力进一步衰落，大夏在河套地区更加稳固。
statement.en:
Yao Xing, emperor of Later Qin, personally led an army to attack Helian Bobo's Xia regime, attempting to recover lost territory in northern Shaanxi. Helian Bobo used a scorched-earth and deep-luring tactic. The Later Qin army, suffering supply difficulties and low morale in the desert, was forced to retreat. The Xia cavalry counterattacked, inflicting heavy losses. This battle further weakened Later Qin and solidified Xia control over the Hetao region.

For Asia in 414 CE, “Later Qin emperor Yao Xing attacks Xia, is defeated and retreats” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 刘裕讨伐司马休之，彻底清除反对势力

summary.zh: 东晋太尉刘裕以荆州刺史司马休之“潜怀异图”为由，率大军西征。司马休之是东晋宗室，拥有雍州、荆州六郡之地，是刘裕最后的主要政敌。晋军击败司马休之军队，司马休之逃往后秦。刘裕兼并了荆、雍二州，东晋境内再无能与刘裕抗衡的势力，距离刘裕篡位仅一步之遥。

title.zh: 后秦皇帝姚兴去世，诸子内讧

summary.zh: 后秦皇帝姚兴病逝，太子姚泓继位。姚兴的其他儿子姚弼、姚愔等人不服，发动兵变争夺皇位。姚泓虽然平定叛乱，但后秦国力因内讧严重削弱，军队士气低落，地方将领纷纷割据自立。东晋太尉刘裕闻讯后，决定趁机北伐后秦。

statement.zh: 后秦皇帝姚兴病逝，太子姚泓继位。姚兴的其他儿子姚弼、姚愔等人不服，发动兵变争夺皇位。姚泓虽然平定叛乱，但后秦国力因内讧严重削弱，军队士气低落，地方将领纷纷割据自立。东晋太尉刘裕闻讯后，决定趁机北伐后秦。
statement.en:
Yao Xing, emperor of Later Qin, died of illness. His crown prince Yao Hong succeeded. However, other sons Yao Bi and Yao Yin refused to accept this, launching mutinies to fight for the throne. Although Yao Hong suppressed the rebellions, Later Qin's power was severely weakened by the internal strife, army morale was low, and regional generals began to secede. When Liu Yu, Grand Commandant of Eastern Jin, heard the news, he decided to take the opportunity to launch a northern expedition against Later Qin.

For Asia in 416 CE, “Later Qin emperor Yao Xing dies; sons fall into internal strife” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 刘裕大举北伐后秦，分兵五路

title.zh: 刘裕北伐军攻克长安，灭亡后秦

summary.zh: 东晋北伐军连破后秦防线，大将王镇恶率水军沿黄河、渭水西进，攻破潼关；檀道济率陆军攻克洛阳。两军在长安城下会师，后秦国主姚泓出降，后秦灭亡。刘裕收复了沦陷近百年的关中地区，晋军在此缴获了大量珍宝、典籍和乐器，声威大震。

statement.zh: 东晋北伐军连破后秦防线，大将王镇恶率水军沿黄河、渭水西进，攻破潼关；檀道济率陆军攻克洛阳。两军在长安城下会师，后秦国主姚泓出降，后秦灭亡。刘裕收复了沦陷近百年的关中地区，晋军在此缴获了大量珍宝、典籍和乐器，声威大震。
statement.en:
The Eastern Jin expeditionary force broke through Later Qin's defenses. General Wang Zhen'e led a naval force west along the Yellow and Wei Rivers, breaching Tong Pass, while Tan Daoji's land force captured Luoyang. The two armies converged on Chang'an. Later Qin emperor Yao Hong surrendered, and Later Qin was destroyed. Liu Yu recovered the Guanzhong region, lost for nearly a century. The Jin army seized great quantities of treasures, books, and musical instruments, greatly enhancing its prestige.

For Asia in 417 CE, “Liu Yu's expeditionary force captures Chang'an, destroys Later Qin” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 萨珊波斯国王巴赫拉姆五世即位

summary.zh: 萨珊波斯帝国国王伊嗣俟一世去世，其子巴赫拉姆五世在阿拉伯部落支持下从希拉城返回泰西封即位。巴赫拉姆五世以猎野驴和传奇故事闻名，他在位期间镇压了贵族叛乱，重新确立了萨珊王朝对亚美尼亚的控制，并与东罗马帝国维持了相对和平的关系。

title.zh: 大夏王赫连勃勃攻占长安，称帝

summary.zh: 大夏王赫连勃勃趁东晋留守军内乱之机，亲率大军围攻长安。留守长安的晋将沈田子、王修、傅弘之等互相猜忌残杀，军心瓦解。赫连勃勃攻克长安，大夏军队在城中大肆杀掠。赫连勃勃在长安称皇帝，改元昌武，大夏成为关中和河套地区的新霸主。

statement.zh: 大夏王赫连勃勃趁东晋留守军内乱之机，亲率大军围攻长安。留守长安的晋将沈田子、王修、傅弘之等互相猜忌残杀，军心瓦解。赫连勃勃攻克长安，大夏军队在城中大肆杀掠。赫连勃勃在长安称皇帝，改元昌武，大夏成为关中和河套地区的新霸主。
statement.en:
Taking advantage of infighting among the Eastern Jin garrison, Xia king Helian Bobo personally led a large army to besiege Chang'an. The Jin generals in Chang'an—Shen Tianzi, Wang Xiu, Fu Hongzhi—mutually suspected and killed each other, causing the army's morale to collapse. Helian Bobo captured Chang'an, and his army plundered the city mercilessly. He proclaimed himself emperor in Chang'an, changing the era name to Changwu. Xia became the new overlord of Guanzhong and Hetao.

In 418 CE, “Xia king Helian Bobo captures Chang'an, proclaims himself emperor” belongs to the field of Military in Asia.

For Asia in 418 CE, “Xia king Helian Bobo captures Chang'an, proclaims himself emperor” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 刘裕派使者赴后秦和凉州索求经典和乐器

summary.zh: 东晋宋公刘裕派遣使者到后秦残部和河西走廊诸政权，索求流散的汉魏典籍、礼乐器和天文仪器。这些文化战利品被运回建康，充实了东晋朝廷的收藏，也为刘裕建立新朝提供了礼仪上的合法性。此举体现了刘裕对汉文化的重视，同时意在以中原正统自居。

title.zh: 汪达尔王国国王盖萨里克与西罗马帝国签订和约

summary.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克率部在北非站稳脚跟后，与西罗马帝国皇帝霍诺里乌斯签订和约。西罗马承认汪达尔人对北非部分地区的统治权，汪达尔人则承认西罗马皇帝的名义宗主权。这一和约为盖萨里克积蓄力量、最终夺取迦太基赢得了时间。

title.zh: 佛经《大般涅槃经》开始在北凉翻译

summary.zh: 北凉国王沮渠蒙逊信奉佛教，在其都城姑臧（今甘肃武威）组织高僧昙无谶翻译《大般涅槃经》。该经阐述了“一切众生皆有佛性”和“涅槃常乐我净”的重要教义，对中国佛教天台宗、华严宗和禅宗都产生了深远影响。

title.zh: 印度数学家发明零的符号和十进制计数法

summary.zh: 笈多王朝时期的印度数学家发明了用圆圈（“0”）表示数字“零”的符号，并完善了十进制位值计数法。这是数学史上划时代的突破，使计算更加简便高效。印度-阿拉伯数字系统后经阿拉伯商人传入欧洲，成为世界通用的计数符号，深刻影响了后世数学、科学和商业的发展。

title.zh: 刘裕实行土断与度田，抑制豪强

summary.zh: 宋武帝刘裕即位后继续推行土断政策，严厉清查隐匿户口和土地。他下令废除侨州郡县，使侨民入籍当地，同时实行度田，将隐户和隐田登记造册，按田亩征税。这些措施打击了世家大族的经济特权，增加了国家财政税收，也激化了刘宋与门阀士族的矛盾。

title.zh: 刘裕接受晋恭帝禅让，建立南朝宋

summary.zh: 东晋宋公刘裕逼迫晋恭帝司马德文禅让帝位，在建康南郊登基称帝，国号宋，改元永初。刘裕是出身寒门庶族的军事将领，他的登基标志着东晋门阀士族政治的终结，中国历史进入南北朝时期。南朝宋的建立重新确立了寒人武将在政治中的主导地位。

statement.zh: 东晋宋公刘裕逼迫晋恭帝司马德文禅让帝位，在建康南郊登基称帝，国号宋，改元永初。刘裕是出身寒门庶族的军事将领，他的登基标志着东晋门阀士族政治的终结，中国历史进入南北朝时期。南朝宋的建立重新确立了寒人武将在政治中的主导地位。
statement.en:
Liu Yu, Duke of Song, forced Emperor Gong of Jin, Sima Dewen, to abdicate and proclaimed himself emperor at the southern suburb of Jiankang, with the dynasty name Song, changing the era name to Yongchu. Liu Yu was a military general of humble origins. His ascension marked the end of aristocratic clan politics in the Eastern Jin and the beginning of the Northern and Southern Dynasties period. The establishment of Liu Song reestablished the dominance of military men of humble origin in politics.

For Asia in 420 CE, “Liu Yu accepts abdication from Emperor Gong of Jin, establishes Liu Song dynasty” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 云锦织造始于南朝

summary.zh: 南京（建康）一带丝织业兴起，云锦以妆花重纬、金线妆彩著称，后世为明清皇家御用织品。

statement.zh:
南京（建康）一带丝织业兴起，云锦以妆花重纬、金线妆彩著称，后世为明清皇家御用织品。织造依赖提花机与熟练织工，妆花工艺把多种色纬织入同一图案，金线与孔雀羽使织物富丽；丝织业与城市经济相连。技艺在宫廷与民间之间传承。

把「云锦织造始于南朝」放回公元420年的中国，可以看到工艺变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Silk weaving rose around Nanjing (Jiankang); Yunjin brocade, famed for juxtaposed wefts and gold thread, later became imperial ware of the Ming and Qing.

title.zh: 西罗马帝国驻不列颠最后一支军队撤离

summary.zh: 西罗马帝国皇帝霍诺里乌斯因高卢和意大利形势危急，下令驻守不列颠的最后一支罗马野战军撤回高卢。不列颠的罗马化城市失去了军事保护，地方贵族开始自行组织防御，盎格鲁-撒克逊人的入侵更加频繁。不列颠的罗马时代正式结束，逐步进入盎格鲁-撒克逊时期。

title.zh: 威尼斯建城

summary.zh: 传统以421年为威尼斯建城之年：亚得里亚海泻湖中的难民在群岛落脚，后以造船与中介贸易崛起为海上共和国，由总督统领，扼守东西方的航路与财富。

statement.zh: 传统以421年为威尼斯建城之年：亚得里亚海泻湖中的难民在群岛落脚，后以造船与中介贸易崛起为海上共和国，由总督统领，扼守东西方的航路与财富。泻湖的浅滩与潮汐为其提供天然屏障，居民以木桩奠基、以运河交通；船厂与商船队支撑其海上势力，共和国的制度亦在冲突中逐步成形。
statement.en: Tradition considers 421 as the year when Venice was founded: refugees from the Adriatic lagoon settled on the islands, and later emerged as a maritime republic through shipbuilding and intermediary trade.

title.zh: 北魏明元帝拓跋嗣去世，太武帝拓跋焘继位

summary.zh: 北魏明元帝拓跋嗣病逝，十五岁的太子拓跋焘继位，是为太武帝。太武帝拓跋焘是中国历史上杰出的军事统帅，他在位期间北破柔然，西灭大夏、北凉，东灭北燕，统一了中国北方，终结了十六国割据局面。他的继位标志着北魏即将进入鼎盛时期。

statement.zh: 北魏明元帝拓跋嗣病逝，15岁的太子拓跋焘继位，是为太武帝。太武帝拓跋焘是中国历史上杰出的军事统帅，他在位期间北破柔然，西灭大夏、北凉，东灭北燕，统一了中国北方，终结了十六国割据局面。他的继位标志着北魏即将进入鼎盛时期。
statement.en:
Emperor Mingyuan of Northern Wei, Tuoba Si, died of illness, and his 15-year-old crown prince Tuoba Tao ascended the throne, known as Emperor Taiwu. Emperor Taiwu was one of the most outstanding military commanders in Chinese history. During his reign, he defeated Rouran in the north, destroyed Xia, Northern Liang, and Northern Yan in the west and east, unifying northern China and ending the Sixteen Kingdoms period. His ascension marked the beginning of the rise of Northern Wei.

For Asia in 422 CE, “Emperor Mingyuan of Northern Wei dies; Emperor Taiwu ascends” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 宋武帝刘裕病逝，宋少帝刘义符继位

summary.zh: 南朝宋开国皇帝刘裕在建康病逝，终年六十岁。太子刘义符继位，是为宋少帝，年仅十七岁。刘裕临终前任命徐羡之、傅亮、谢晦、檀道济四位大臣辅政。宋少帝荒淫无度，不理朝政，为后来辅政大臣废黜他埋下了祸根。

statement.zh: 南朝宋开国皇帝刘裕在建康病逝，终年60岁。太子刘义符继位，是为宋少帝，年仅17岁。刘裕临终前任命徐羡之、傅亮、谢晦、檀道济四位大臣辅政。宋少帝荒淫无度，不理朝政，为后来辅政大臣废黜他埋下了祸根。
statement.en:
Liu Yu, founding emperor of the Liu Song dynasty, died of illness in Jiankang at age 60. His crown prince Liu Yifu ascended the throne, known as Emperor Shao of Song, only 17 years old. On his deathbed, Liu Yu appointed four regents: Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang, Xie Hui, and Tan Daoji. Emperor Shao was dissolute and ignored state affairs, laying the seeds for his subsequent deposition by the regents.

For Asia in 422 CE, “Emperor Wu of Song dies; Emperor Shao of Song ascends” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 北魏攻克虎牢关，刘宋北方防线崩溃

summary.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘率军猛攻刘宋的黄河防线重镇虎牢关（今河南荥阳汜水镇）。刘宋守将毛德祖坚守二百余日，弹尽粮绝，最终城破被俘。北魏占领虎牢关，刘宋在河南的防线全面崩溃，退守淮水一线。

statement.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘率军猛攻刘宋的黄河防线重镇虎牢关（今河南荥阳汜水镇）。刘宋守将毛德祖坚守二百余日，弹尽粮绝，最终城破被俘。北魏占领虎牢关，刘宋在河南的防线全面崩溃，退守淮水一线。
statement.en:
In 423, Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei led his army in a fierce assault on the strategic fortress of Hulao Pass (in modern Xingyang, Henan) on Liu Song's Yellow River defense line. Liu Song commander Mao Dezhu held out for over two hundred days before running out of supplies and being captured. With the fall of Hulao Pass, Liu Song's defenses in Henan completely collapsed, and they retreated to the Huai River line.

For Asia in 423 CE, “Northern Wei captures Hulao Pass; Liu Song northern defenses collapse” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

After the death of Hun king Rugila, his nephews Attila and Bleda jointly succeeded as the rulers of the Huns. Attila was about 17 years old but had already shown exceptional military talent and political ambition. Under their joint leadership, the Hun Empire expanded further, posing an increasing threat to the Eastern Roman Empire. title.zh: 徐羡之等废黜宋少帝，迎立宋文帝

summary.zh: 辅政大臣徐羡之、傅亮、谢晦以宋少帝刘义符荒淫无道为由，发动政变废黜少帝，不久将其杀害。他们迎立刘裕第三子、宜都王刘义隆为帝，是为宋文帝。刘义隆继位后，表面安抚辅政大臣，暗中开始策划铲除这些权臣。

statement.zh: 辅政大臣徐羡之、傅亮、谢晦以宋少帝刘义符荒淫无道为由，发动政变废黜少帝，不久将其杀害。他们迎立刘裕第三子、宜都王刘义隆为帝，是为宋文帝。刘义隆继位后，表面安抚辅政大臣，暗中开始策划铲除这些权臣。
statement.en:
The regents Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang, and Xie Hui, claiming that Emperor Shao of Song (Liu Yifu) was dissolute and immoral, launched a coup to depose him and soon had him killed. They installed Liu Yu's third son, the Prince of Yidu, Liu Yilong, as emperor (Emperor Wen of Song). After ascending, Emperor Wen outwardly appeased the regents while secretly planning to eliminate them.

For Asia in 423 CE, “Xu Xianzhi etc. depose Emperor Shao of Song, install Emperor Wen of Song” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 北魏太武帝亲征柔然，大破敕勒

summary.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军北伐，深入漠北，讨伐柔然汗国和敕勒（高车）部落。魏军在弱水（今蒙古国境内）大破柔然军队，柔然可汗大檀率部远遁。拓跋焘在漠北刻石记功而还，此战大大削弱了柔然的实力，巩固了北魏北方边境。

statement.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军北伐，深入漠北，讨伐柔然汗国和敕勒（高车）部落。魏军在弱水（今蒙古国境内）大破柔然军队，柔然可汗大檀率部远遁。拓跋焘在漠北刻石记功而还，此战大大削弱了柔然的实力，巩固了北魏北方边境。
statement.en:
Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei led a large army north deep into the desert to attack the Rouran Khaganate and the Chile (Gaoche) tribes. The Wei forces heavily defeated the Rouran army at the Ruo River (modern Mongolia), and the Rouran khagan Datan fled far away. Taiwu had an inscription carved on a cliff to commemorate the victory. This campaign greatly weakened Rouran and consolidated Northern Wei's northern border.

For Asia in 424 CE, “Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei personally campaigns against Rouran, defeats Chile” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 东罗马帝国与萨珊波斯爆发边境战争

summary.zh: 东罗马帝国与萨珊波斯帝国因争夺亚美尼亚的控制权再次爆发战争。东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世派兵进攻波斯边境，双方互有胜负。战事持续数年，最终以和约收场，亚美尼亚被两国瓜分，东罗马获得西亚美尼亚，波斯获得东亚美尼亚。

title.zh: 宋文帝诛杀徐羡之、傅亮，铲除辅政大臣

title.zh: 宋文帝提倡儒学，开办四学馆

summary.zh: 宋文帝刘义隆下诏在京师建康开设儒学、玄学、史学、文学四馆，延揽天下名士讲授。这是中国历史上第一次由官方设立的综合性学术机构，打破了汉以来只立太学、专授儒经的传统，促进了魏晋以来新学术的发展，对后世教育制度影响深远。

statement.en: Emperor Wen of Song issued an edict to establish four academies in the capital Jiankang: Confucian, Metaphysical (Xuanxue), Historical, and Literary, inviting renowned scholars from across the land to lecture.

title.zh: 汪达尔王国国王盖萨里克大规模建设海军

summary.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克为了控制地中海，在北非港口大规模建造战舰，组建了一支战斗力极强的海军。汪达尔海军采用轻型快艇战术，擅长突袭和登船作战。这支舰队后来成为地中海西部的海上霸主，多次劫掠罗马和希腊海岸，并在455年洗劫了罗马城。

title.zh: 君士坦丁堡狄奥多西城墙全面竣工

summary.zh: 东罗马帝国皇帝狄奥多西二世下令修建的君士坦丁堡陆墙正式完工。该城墙由内墙、外墙和护城河组成，高约12米，全长约5.6公里，是古代世界最坚固的城防系统之一。此后的千余年间，君士坦丁堡凭借该城墙多次抵御了阿瓦尔人、阿拉伯人、罗斯人和保加尔人的围攻。

statement.zh: 东罗马帝国皇帝狄奥多西二世下令修建的君士坦丁堡陆墙正式完工。
statement.en: The land walls of Constantinople, ordered by Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius II, were formally completed.

title.zh: 聂斯托利派基督教争论激化，引发宗教冲突

summary.zh: 君士坦丁堡牧首聂斯托利主张基督的神性和人性是分开的，反对称呼圣母玛利亚为“上帝之母”，而应称为“基督之母”。这一观点引发了亚历山大城牧首西里尔的强烈反对，双方在教义上激烈争论。东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世试图调解，但矛盾越来越激化，为431年以弗所公会议的召开埋下伏笔。

title.zh: 陶渊明病逝

summary.zh: 东晋著名诗人、田园诗派的开创者陶渊明在浔阳柴桑（今江西九江）病逝，享年约六十一岁。陶渊明一生五次出仕、五次归隐，最终彻底归隐田园。他创作的《桃花源记》《归去来兮辞》《饮酒》《五柳先生传》等作品，描绘了理想中的世外桃源和自得其乐的田园生活，对后世中国文学和隐逸文化产生了极其深远的影响。

statement.en:
Tao Yuanming, the renowned Eastern Jin poet and founder of the pastoral poetry school, died of illness in Xunyang Chaisang (modern Jiujiang, Jiangxi), at about 61 years of age. Tao Yuanming had entered official service five times and retired five times, finally retiring completely to the countryside. His works 'The Peach Blossom Spring,' 'Returning Home,' 'Drinking Wine,' and 'The Biography of Master Five Willows' depicted an ideal utopia and a contented rural life, profoundly influencing later Chinese literature and the culture of reclusion.

For Asia in 426 CE, “Tao Yuanming dies of illness” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 高句丽长寿王迁都平壤

summary.zh: 高句丽第二十代君主长寿王高琏在位十五年，将都城自国内城（今吉林集安）南迁至平壤。此举把国家重心从辽东山城地带移向大同江流域的农耕平原，标志着高句丽的扩张方向由中原一侧转向朝鲜半岛南部，加强了对百济与新罗的压力。长寿王在位七十九年，是高句丽史上御宇最久的君主，其间既与北魏、南朝双向通使以求平衡，又于475年攻破百济汉城、杀盖卤王，高句丽国势达于极盛。

statement.zh: 高句丽第二十代君主长寿王高琏在位十五年，将都城自国内城（今吉林集安）南迁至平壤。此举把国家重心从辽东山城地带移向大同江流域的农耕平原，标志着高句丽的扩张方向由中原一侧转向朝鲜半岛南部。加强了对百济与新罗的压力。长寿王在位79年，是高句丽史上御宇最久的君主，其间既与北魏、南朝双向通使以求平衡，又于475年攻破百济汉城、杀盖卤王，高句丽国势达于极盛。
statement.en:
In the fifteenth year of his reign, Jangsu (Go Ryeon), twentieth ruler of Goguryeo, moved the capital south from Guknaeseong (modern Ji'an, Jilin) to Pyongyang. The move shifted the kingdom's centre of gravity from the mountain fortresses of Liaodong to the farming plain of the Taedong river, redirecting Goguryeo's expansion away from China and towards the southern peninsula, and increasing pressure on Baekje and Silla. Jangsu reigned 79 years, the longest in Goguryeo history, balancing embassies to both the Northern Wei and the Southern Dynasties while in 475 storming the Baekje capital of Hanseong and killing King Gaero, bringing Goguryeo to its greatest extent.

It sits within the timeline's chronological coverage of Goguryeo and politics history.

title.zh: 刘宋元嘉之治进入鼎盛，政局安定

summary.zh: 宋文帝刘义隆铲除权臣后，推行轻徭薄赋、与民休息的政策，大力发展农业、手工业和商业。刘宋境内社会安定，户口大增，仓库充实。文学、史学、玄学、儒学都得到长足发展，史称“元嘉之治”。这一时期是南朝一百七十年的政治、经济、文化鼎盛时期。

statement.zh: 宋文帝刘义隆铲除权臣后，推行轻徭薄赋、与民休息的政策，大力发展农业、手工业和商业。刘宋境内社会安定，户口大增，仓库充实。文学、史学、玄学、儒学都得到长足发展，史称“元嘉之治”。这一时期是南朝一百七十年的政治、经济、文化鼎盛时期。
statement.en:
After eliminating the regents, Emperor Wen of Song implemented policies of light taxation, rest with the people, and greatly developed agriculture, handicrafts, and commerce. Within Liu Song, society was stable, household numbers greatly increased, and granaries were full. Literature, history, metaphysics, and Confucianism all flourished, known as the 'Yuanjia Administration.' This was the political, economic, and cultural heyday of the Southern Dynasties for 170 years.

For Asia in 428 CE, “Yuanjia administration reaches its peak; political stability achieved” is a traceable node of Economy change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 以弗所公会议召开，聂斯托利派被定为异端

summary.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世在以弗所召开第三次基督教大公会议，讨论聂斯托利的教义问题。会议在亚历山大城牧首西里尔的主持下，宣布聂斯托利派为异端，聂斯托利被流放。聂斯托利派的信徒后来向东传播，进入波斯、印度和中国（景教），对东方基督教的发展产生了重要影响。

title.zh: 北魏太武帝第二次大举北伐柔然，勒石刻功

summary.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率骑兵六万，再次北伐柔然。魏军轻装疾进，深入漠北三千里，大破柔然主力。柔然可汗大檀率残部逃走，部众数十万投降北魏。拓跋焘在柔然故地勒石刻功，“漠南无王庭”。柔然从此一蹶不振，北魏北疆得以长治久安。

statement.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率骑兵六万，再次北伐柔然。魏军轻装疾进，深入漠北三千里，大破柔然主力。柔然可汗大檀率残部逃走，部众数十万投降北魏。拓跋焘在柔然故地勒石刻功，“漠南无王庭”。柔然从此一蹶不振，北魏北疆得以长治久安。
statement.en:
Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei personally led 60,000 cavalry north again against the Rouran. The Wei forces advanced light and fast, penetrating over 3,000 li into the desert, breaking the main Rouran army. Rouran khagan Datan fled with his remnants, and 100,000 surrendered. Taiwu had an inscription carved at the site, proclaiming 'No royal court south of the Gobi.' The Rouran never recovered, and the northern frontier of Northern Wei was secure for a long time.

For Asia in 429 CE, “Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei launches second major campaign against Rouran, carves inscription” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 爱尔兰修道士开始大规模手抄拉丁文经卷

summary.zh: 爱尔兰的修道院在欧洲大陆一片混乱的时期，保存了大量的拉丁文经卷和古典文献。爱尔兰修道士在修道院中设立缮写室，大规模手抄《圣经》、教父著作和少量古典拉丁文学作品。这项文化保存工作使爱尔兰成为中世纪早期的“学者之岛”，后来许多爱尔兰传教士将欧洲大陆的基督教信仰重新点燃。

title.zh: 刘宋北伐军失败，尽失河南地

summary.zh: 刘宋大将到彦之北伐失败后，北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军南下追击。刘宋在河南的防线全面崩溃，滑台、虎牢、洛阳、金墉等城相继陷落。刘宋将士伤亡惨重，只退守淮水南岸。此战之后，刘宋与北魏的边境线稳定在淮水一线，刘宋彻底失去了收复中原的希望。

title.zh: 希波主教奥古斯丁在汪达尔人围城期间去世

summary.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克率军围攻北非城市希波（今阿尔及利亚安纳巴）。城内年迈的希波主教、基督教神学家奥古斯丁在围城期间身患重病，于八月二十八日去世，享年七十六岁。奥古斯丁一生撰写了《忏悔录》《上帝之城》《三位一体论》等巨著，系统阐述了基督教神学，对中世纪乃至整个西方基督教思想产生了不可估量的影响。奥古斯丁去世后不久，希波城陷落。

statement.en:
Vandal king Gaiseric besieged the North African city of Hippo Regius (modern Annaba, Algeria). The elderly bishop of Hippo, the Christian theologian Augustine, fell seriously ill during the siege and died on August 28 at age 76. Augustine wrote great works such as 'Confessions,' 'The City of God,' and 'On the Trinity,' systematically expounding Christian theology. His influence on medieval and even all of Western Christian thought is immeasurable. Hippo fell soon after his death.

In 430 CE, “Augustine of Hippo dies during Vandal siege of Hippo Regius” belongs to the field of Religion in Africa.

For Africa in 430 CE, “Augustine of Hippo dies during Vandal siege of Hippo Regius” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 匈人（匈奴）阿提拉和布莱达大举入侵东罗马帝国

summary.zh: 匈奴国王阿提拉和布莱达联合率军渡过多瑙河，大举入侵东罗马帝国的巴尔干行省。匈奴骑兵横扫色雷斯、马其顿等地，洗劫了七十余座城市，一直推进到君士坦丁堡城下。东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世被迫求和，答应支付巨额黄金作为赎金，并割让多瑙河南岸部分地区。

summary.zh: 北凉国王沮渠蒙逊趁西秦被大夏灭后内乱，率军进攻西秦残余势力，攻占重要军事据点枹罕（今甘肃临夏）。北凉控制了黄河上游和陇西部分地区，国力大增，成为河西走廊最强大的政权。

title.zh: 匈奴国王阿提拉和布莱达再次入侵东罗马

summary.zh: 匈奴国王阿提拉和布莱达以东罗马帝国未完全履行和约支付黄金为由，再次率军渡过多瑙河。匈奴军队洗劫了伊利里亚和色雷斯地区的城市，迫使东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世将年贡黄金提高一倍。东罗马帝国财政陷入困境。

title.zh: 刘宋益州爆发赵广起义，持续半年

summary.zh: 刘宋益州（今四川、重庆一带）因刺史施政苛刻，百姓负担沉重，爆发了赵广领导的农民起义。起义军一度攻占成都周边的多个县城，拥众数万。刘宋朝廷派兵镇压，经过半年激战，起义军最终失败。这次起义暴露了刘宋地方治理的弊端。

title.zh: 圣帕特里克开始在爱尔兰传教

summary.zh: 基督教传教士帕特里克（后来被称为圣帕特里克）从高卢前往爱尔兰，开始大规模的传教活动。帕特里克成功地使爱尔兰的部落首领和国王改宗基督教，并在全岛建立了教堂、修道院和主教区。爱尔兰几乎未受罗马帝国影响的独特环境，使当地基督教发展出特有的修道院制度。

title.zh: 西哥特王国在提奥多里克一世领导下继续扩张

summary.zh: 西哥特国王提奥多里克一世利用西罗马帝国的虚弱，率军向北扩张，占领了高卢东南部的纳博讷、阿尔勒等城市。西哥特王国的领土从高卢的阿基坦延伸到地中海沿岸，成为西欧最强大的蛮族王国之一。

title.zh: 南朝宋诗人谢灵运被宋文帝处死

summary.zh: 南朝宋山水诗人、谢玄之孙谢灵运因卷入刘宋宗室权力斗争，被宋文帝刘义隆以“叛逆罪”下令处死。谢灵运在临刑前写下“辞赋华美，性命不保”的诗句，终年四十九岁。谢灵运开创了中国文学史上的山水诗派，其诗歌对后世王维、孟浩然等诗人影响深远。

statement.zh: 南朝宋山水诗人、谢玄之孙谢灵运因卷入刘宋宗室权力斗争，被宋文帝刘义隆以“叛逆罪”下令处死。谢灵运在临刑前写下“辞赋华美，性命不保”的诗句，终年49岁。谢灵运开创了中国文学史上的山水诗派，其诗歌对后世王维、孟浩然等诗人影响深远。
statement.en:
Xie Lingyun, a landscape poet of the Liu Song dynasty and grandson of Xie Xuan, became involved in the power struggles of the Liu Song imperial clan. Emperor Wen of Song ordered his execution on charges of treason. Before his death, Xie Lingyun wrote verses lamenting that 'a brilliant writer may not keep his life.' He was 49. Xie Lingyun founded the landscape poetry school in Chinese literary history, deeply influencing later poets such as Wang Wei and Meng Haoran.

For Asia in 433 CE, “Liu Song poet Xie Lingyun executed by Emperor Wen of Song” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 东罗马帝国向匈奴支付巨额年贡，换取和平

summary.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世因无力抵御匈奴，与匈奴国王阿提拉和布莱达达成新的和约。东罗马帝国每年向匈奴支付黄金七百磅，同时赎回大量战俘。这是东罗马帝国第一次正式向蛮族首领缴纳年贡，阿提拉借此称霸中欧，建立了一个庞大的游牧帝国。

statement.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世因无力抵御匈奴，与匈奴国王阿提拉和布莱达达成新的和约。东罗马帝国每年向匈奴支付黄金七百磅，同时赎回大量战俘。这是东罗马帝国第一次正式向蛮族首领缴纳年贡，阿提拉借此称霸中欧，建立了一个庞大的游牧帝国。
statement.en:
Unable to resist the Huns, Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius II reached a new treaty with Attila and Bleda. The Eastern Roman Empire would pay 700 pounds of gold annually to the Huns, as well as ransom for many captives. This was the first time the Eastern Roman Empire formally paid an annual tribute to a barbarian chieftain. Attila used this wealth to dominate central Europe, establishing a vast nomadic empire.

For Europe in 433 CE, “Eastern Roman Empire pays huge annual tribute to the Huns in exchange for peace” is a traceable node of Diplomacy change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 刘宋与北魏在汝水、颍水一带持续冲突

summary.zh: 刘宋与北魏的边境摩擦不断升级，双方在汝水（今河南汝河）、颍水（今安徽颍河）流域多次交火。刘宋将领到彦之、王仲德率军抵抗，但多以防守为主，未能突破北魏防线。南北朝对立的格局基本形成。

statement.en: Border friction between Liu Song and Northern Wei continued to escalate, with repeated skirmishes in the Ru River (modern Ruhe, Henan) and Ying River (modern Yinghe, Anhui) basins.

title.zh: 东罗马帝国修建多瑙河防线，应对匈奴威胁

summary.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世在北部的多瑙河沿线修建了数百公里的堡垒和城墙，以防御匈奴骑兵的侵袭。这条防线称为“多瑙河防线”，由数十座要塞和边墙组成，驻守数万军队。但匈奴骑兵机动性极强，经常绕过防线从多个渡口突入。

title.zh: 东罗马帝国颁布《狄奥多西法典》

summary.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世下令编纂的《狄奥多西法典》正式颁布。这部法典汇集了君士坦丁大帝以来一百余年间罗马皇帝颁布的所有法令，共十六卷，涉及行政、刑法、民法、宗教等各个方面。法典成为东罗马帝国此后法律的基础，对中世纪欧洲法律的发展也产生了重要影响。

statement.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世下令编纂的《狄奥多西法典》正式颁布。这部法典汇集了君士坦丁大帝以来一百余年间罗马皇帝颁布的所有法令，共十六卷，涉及行政、刑法、民法、宗教等各个方面。法典成为东罗马帝国此后法律的基础，对中世纪欧洲法律的发展也产生了重要影响。
statement.en:
In 435, the Theodosian Code, ordered compiled by Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius II, was formally issued. This code collected all the edicts issued by Roman emperors from Constantine I to Theodosius II, covering a hundred years, in 16 books covering administration, criminal law, civil law, religion, and more. It became the foundation of Eastern Roman law and significantly influenced the development of medieval European law.

For Europe in 435 CE, “Eastern Roman Empire issues Theodosian Code” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 《狄奥多西法典》：把皇帝敕令编成官方法典

summary.zh: 438年，狄奥多西二世治下出版《狄奥多西法典》，收录自君士坦丁一世以来的皇帝敕令，并禁止异教、惩罚异端。

statement.zh: 438年，狄奥多西二世治下，《狄奥多西法典》在东部帝国出版。它把自君士坦丁一世以来的皇帝敕令编成一部官方法典，也包括312年以后发布的敕令。
statement.en: In 438, under Theodosius II, the Theodosian Code was published in the Eastern Empire. It codified imperial constitutions from the reign of Constantine I onward, including laws issued after 312.

sources.locator: Quick Summary, sentences 1–2; Theodosius II entry, compilation sentence
sources.excerpt: The Theodosian Code was a compilation of Roman laws issued by Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius II. Published in 438 CE, it codified imperial constitutions from the reign of Constantine I onward.

zh: 438年，狄奥多西二世治下，《狄奥多西法典》在东部帝国出版。它把自君士坦丁一世以来的皇帝敕令编成一部官方法典，也包括312年以后发布的敕令。
en: In 438, under Theodosius II, the Theodosian Code was published in the Eastern Empire. It codified imperial constitutions from the reign of Constantine I onward, including laws issued after 312.

note.zh: “312年以后”来自同一条目的另句：codified the laws issued after 312。
note.en: 'After 312' comes from the same entry: codified the laws issued after 312.

statement.zh: 法典不只是整理条文，也把宗教边界写进法律：它禁止异教，惩罚异端。

sources.excerpt: The code also included laws that banned paganism and penalized heresy.

zh: 法典不只是整理条文，也把宗教边界写进法律：它禁止异教，惩罚异端。
en: The code did more than arrange rules: it banned paganism and penalized heresy.

note.zh: “宗教边界”是对 banned paganism / penalized heresy 的概括。
note.en: 'Religious boundary' summarizes the ban on paganism and penalty for heresy.

statement.zh: 它被视为罗马法整理与标准化的重要一步。
statement.en: It was a major step in organizing and standardizing Roman law.

sources.excerpt: The code was a major step in organizing and standardizing Roman law.

zh: 它被视为罗马法整理与标准化的重要一步。
en: It was a major step in organizing and standardizing Roman law.

note.zh: 这是不列颠的编辑评价，不是现代法学定论。
note.en: This is Britannica's editorial assessment, not a settled modern legal verdict.

statement.zh: 但它不是一部全新的法典，而是皇帝敕令的汇编；把散落的条文按主题收拢，官员才能在治理中引用同一套规则。
statement.en: But it was not a wholly new code; it was a compilation of imperial laws, arranged by subject so that officials could cite one set of rules.

sources.excerpt: The Theodosian Code was a compilation of Roman laws issued by Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius II.

zh: 但它不是一部全新的法典，而是皇帝敕令的汇编；把散落的条文按主题收拢，官员才能在治理中引用同一套规则。
en: But it was not a wholly new code; it was a compilation of imperial laws, arranged by subject so that officials could cite one set of rules.

note.zh: “按主题收拢、方便引用”是编纂汇编的功能解释。
note.en: 'Arranged by subject, easy to cite' explains the function of a compilation.

statement.zh: 法律统一也带来另一面：帝国用法律把正统与异端分开，宗教异议因此变成政治问题。
statement.en: Legal unification had another side: the empire used law to separate orthodoxy from heresy, and religious dissent became a political matter.

title.zh: 匈奴国王阿提拉进攻色萨利和希腊中部

title.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克攻陷迦太基，建立汪达尔王国

summary.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克率军攻陷北非首府迦太基，并在该城正式建立汪达尔王国。盖萨里克没收了罗马贵族和天主教会的土地，分配给汪达尔战士。汪达尔人信奉阿里乌派基督教，对天主教徒实行宗教歧视和迫害。罗马帝国最重要的粮仓落入蛮族之手，帝国经济崩溃。

title.zh: 北魏太武帝率军西征，灭亡北凉，统一北方

summary.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘以“北凉与柔然勾结”为名，亲率大军从平城出发，千里奔袭北凉都城姑臧（今甘肃武威）。北凉国王沮渠牧犍投降，北凉灭亡。北魏控制了河西走廊，打通了通往西域的通道，结束了五胡十六国的割据局面，统一了中国北方。

statement.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘以“北凉与柔然勾结”为名，亲率大军从平城出发，1000里奔袭北凉都城姑臧（今甘肃武威）。北凉国王沮渠牧犍投降，北凉灭亡。北魏控制了河西走廊，打通了通往西域的通道，结束了五胡十六国的割据局面，统一了中国北方。
statement.en:
Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei, using the pretext of 'Northern Liang colluding with Rouran,' personally led a large army from Pingcheng on a thousand-li lightning strike against the Northern Liang capital Guzang (modern Wuwei, Gansu). Northern Liang king Juqu Mujian surrendered, and Northern Liang was destroyed. Northern Wei took control of the Hexi Corridor, opened the route to the Western Regions, ended the fragmentation of the Sixteen Kingdoms, and unified northern China.

For Asia in 439 CE, “Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei leads western expedition, destroys Northern Liang, unifies north” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 北凉残余势力在河西走廊发动起义

summary.zh: 北魏占领河西走廊后，部分北凉残余贵族和佛教僧侣在张掖、酒泉等地发动反魏起义。起义得到河西走廊汉族豪强的响应，声势浩大。北魏太武帝拓跋焘派大军镇压，经过数月激战平定起义，屠杀了数千参与者。

title.zh: 东罗马帝国与匈奴战争再起，巴尔干遭劫

title.zh: 萨克森人开始大规模入侵不列颠东部海岸

title.zh: 匈奴王阿提拉征服巴尔干半岛内陆

summary.zh: 匈奴国王阿提拉率军征服了巴尔干半岛内陆的部落，包括格皮德人、斯基尔人、赫鲁利人等日耳曼部落和萨尔马特游牧部落。阿提拉将这些部落纳入匈奴帝国，要求他们提供军队和物资，匈奴帝国的势力范围从中欧一直延伸到底格里斯河（今伊拉克）。

title.zh: 百济毗有王在位，与南朝交往频繁

summary.zh: 百济国王毗有王在位期间，与南朝宋保持密切的外交联系，多次遣使进贡。百济通过海路与刘宋进行贸易，学习南朝的文化制度和佛教经典。百济成为连接中国大陆与日本列岛的文化桥梁。

title.zh: 刘宋朝廷商议再次北伐，因内部反对作罢

summary.zh: 宋文帝刘义隆见北魏大军西征北凉、南征空虚，打算趁机北伐收复中原。但大臣王玄谟、江湛等劝阻，认为刘宋国力尚未恢复，仓促北伐必败。经过争论，宋文帝放弃北伐计划。这一决策使刘宋错失了最后一次收复中原的机会。

title.zh: 东罗马遣使波斯，尝试共同对抗匈奴

title.zh: 匈奴王阿提拉完全统一匈奴帝国，兄弟布莱达疑似被杀

title.zh: 罗马教皇利奥一世与匈奴王阿提拉会面，劝说其放弃进攻罗马

summary.zh: 西罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世仓皇逃离罗马城后，罗马教皇利奥一世出城与匈奴王阿提拉会面。教皇凭借其个人魅力和宗教权威，成功劝说阿提拉放弃进攻罗马城。阿提拉接受大量黄金后撤军，罗马城暂时幸免于难。这一事件后来被基督教历史学家赋予宗教色彩，成为中世纪教权高于皇权的早期依据。

statement.en: After Western Roman Emperor Valentinian III fled Rome in panic, Pope Leo I went out to meet Attila.

title.zh: 卢水胡盖吴在杏城起义，联络刘宋

summary.zh: 卢水胡首领盖吴在北魏境内的杏城（今陕西黄陵）发动起义，称天台王。起义军声势浩大，聚集十余万人，攻占了关中多个县城。盖吴派使者向刘宋求援，宋文帝刘义隆封盖吴为雍州刺史，但迟迟未发援军。北魏太武帝拓跋焘率军镇压，起义最终失败。

title.zh: 刘宋与北魏在汝南、新蔡一带交战

summary.zh: 刘宋将领到彦之、王玄谟等在汝南（今河南汝南）和新蔡（今河南新蔡）一带与北魏军队交战。双方互有胜负，刘宋未能突破北魏防线，魏军也没有渡过淮水。这场边境冲突是元嘉年间南北战争的延续。

title.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克洗劫罗马城，带走大量财宝

summary.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克应西罗马皇后欧多克西娅之邀（她在丈夫死后被新皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世侮辱），率舰队从北非出发，攻陷罗马城。汪达尔军队在城中大洗劫十四天，掠走了犹太教圣殿的金灯台、罗马元老院的黄金等无数珍宝，还俘虏了皇后和两位公主。这次洗劫比410年西哥特人的劫掠更为彻底，从此“汪达尔主义”成为毁灭文明的代名词。

statement.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克应西罗马皇后欧多克西娅之邀（她在丈夫死后被新皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世侮辱），率舰队从北非出发，攻陷罗马城。
statement.en: At the invitation of the Western Roman empress Eudoxia (who had been insulted by the new emperor Valentinian III after her husband's death), Vandal king Gaiseric led his fleet from North Africa to capture Rome.

en: At the invitation of the Western Roman empress Eudoxia (who had been insulted by the new emperor Valentinian III after her husband's death), Vandal king Gaiseric led his fleet from North Africa to capture Rome.

title.zh: 北魏太武帝下诏灭佛，焚毁佛经佛像

summary.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘因宠信道士寇谦之，加上镇压盖吴起义时在长安寺院发现大量兵器和藏匿妇女，下诏在全国范围内灭佛。诏令焚烧佛经、佛像，拆毁寺院，坑杀僧侣。这是中国历史上第一次大规模的灭佛运动（“三武一宗”灭佛之首），北方佛教遭到毁灭性打击，大量僧侣南逃刘宋。

statement.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘因宠信道士寇谦之，加上镇压盖吴起义时在长安寺院发现大量兵器和藏匿妇女，下诏在全国范围内灭佛。诏令焚烧佛经、佛像，拆毁寺院，坑杀僧侣。这是中国历史上第一次大规模的灭佛运动（“三武一宗”灭佛之首），北方佛教遭到毁灭性打击，大量僧侣南逃刘宋。
statement.en:
Under the influence of the Taoist Kou Qianzhi, whom he favored, and after discovering weapons and concealed women in Chang'an monasteries during the suppression of Gai Wu's rebellion, Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei issued an edict to destroy Buddhism throughout the empire. The edict ordered the burning of Buddhist scriptures and images, the demolition of temples, and the execution of monks. This was the first large-scale persecution of Buddhism in Chinese history (the first of the 'Three Wu and One Zong' persecutions). Buddhism in the north was devastated, and many monks fled south to Liu Song.

For Asia in 446 CE, “Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei issues edict to destroy Buddhism, burn scriptures and images” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 匈奴王阿提拉再次入侵东罗马，直逼君士坦丁堡

summary.zh: 447年，阿提拉以东罗马拖欠贡金为由再度大举南下。匈奴骑兵突破多瑙河防线，在乌图斯河畔击溃东罗马野战军，洗劫伊利里亚、色雷斯与马其顿，前锋直抵君士坦丁堡城外。所幸狄奥多西城墙虽在前一年的大地震中多处坍塌，已由禁军与市民昼夜抢修完毕，匈奴缺乏攻城手段，只得止步。狄奥多西二世被迫求和：补缴积欠贡金六千磅黄金，并将多瑙河以南宽约五日行程的地带划为无人区。

statement.en: In 447 Attila marched south again, alleging that the Eastern Empire had fallen behind on its tribute.

title.zh: 日本允恭天皇去世，安康天皇继位，爆发大伴氏之乱

summary.zh: 日本允恭天皇去世后，其子安康天皇继位。但安康天皇与大伴氏发生冲突，大伴氏被灭族。这场内乱导致大伴氏一族的衰落，苏我氏逐渐崛起。日本早期国家统一进程受到影响。

statement.zh: 日本允恭天皇去世后，其子安康天皇继位。但安康天皇与大伴氏发生冲突，大伴氏被灭族。这场内乱导致大伴氏一族的衰落，苏我氏逐渐崛起。日本早期国家统一进程受到影响。
statement.en:
Emperor Yuryaku (also known as Ohatsuse Wakatakeru no Mikoto) of the Yamato court ascended the throne. He was a powerful ruler who conquered local magnates in the east and west, strengthening centralization. He sent envoys to the Liu Song court, which appointed him 'General Who Pacifies the East, King of Wa' (Japan).

For Asia in 447 CE, “Emperor Yuryaku of Japan ascends; strengthens centralization” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世病逝，马尔西安继位

summary.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世因骑马坠落致伤去世，享年五十岁。元老院推举护国公马尔西安为帝。马尔西安一改狄奥多西二世向匈奴纳贡求和的策略，宣布停止向匈奴支付贡金，并加强君士坦丁堡和多瑙河的防御。阿提拉闻讯大怒，准备西征。

statement.zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世因骑马坠落致伤去世，享年50岁。元老院推举护国公马尔西安为帝。马尔西安一改狄奥多西二世向匈奴纳贡求和的策略，宣布停止向匈奴支付贡金，并加强君士坦丁堡和多瑙河的防御。阿提拉闻讯大怒，准备西征。
statement.en:
Theodosius II died of injuries from a riding accident at age 50. The Senate elected the comes domesticorum Marcian as emperor. Marcian reversed Theodosius II's policy of paying tribute to the Huns, announcing the cessation of payments and strengthening the defenses of Constantinople and the Danube. Attila was enraged upon hearing the news and prepared a western campaign.

For Europe in 448 CE, “Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius II dies; Marcian ascends” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 刘宋大举北伐——元嘉第二次北伐

summary.zh: 宋文帝刘义隆不顾大臣反对，以王玄谟为统帅，出兵三十万，兵分三路大举北伐北魏。刘宋军队一度收复滑台、洛阳、虎牢等地。但王玄谟在围攻滑台时指挥失误，北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军南下反击，刘宋军队全线崩溃，损失惨重，元嘉之治积累的国力基本耗尽。

statement.zh: 宋文帝刘义隆不顾大臣反对，以王玄谟为统帅，出兵三十万，兵分三路大举北伐北魏。刘宋军队一度收复滑台、洛阳、虎牢等地。但王玄谟在围攻滑台时指挥失误，北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军南下反击，刘宋军队全线崩溃，损失惨重，元嘉之治积累的国力基本耗尽。
statement.en:
Ignoring opposition from his ministers, Emperor Wen of Song dispatched a force of 300,000 under the overall command of Wang Xuanmo, divided into three routes, for a massive northern expedition against Northern Wei. The Liu Song army temporarily recaptured Huatai, Luoyang, and Hulao. But Wang Xuanmo made strategic errors while besieging Huatai, and Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei led his army south in a counterattack. The Liu Song forces collapsed completely, suffering heavy losses, exhausting the economic strength accumulated during the Yuanjia administration.

For Asia in 449 CE, “Liu Song launches massive northern expedition — the second Yuanjia northern expedition” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 刘宋元嘉北伐惨败，江北惨遭屠戮

summary.zh: 刘宋北伐军在滑台、洛阳前线大败后，北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军南征，进攻刘宋江北地区。魏军攻克悬瓠、项城等地，一度攻到瓜步（今南京六合），隔江威胁建康。魏军在江北大肆屠城，杀伤无数，刘宋元气大伤，“元嘉之治”至此结束。

statement.zh: 刘宋北伐军在滑台、洛阳前线大败后，北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军南征，进攻刘宋江北地区。魏军攻克悬瓠、项城等地，一度攻到瓜步（今南京六合），隔江威胁建康。魏军在江北大肆屠城，杀伤无数，刘宋元气大伤，“元嘉之治”至此结束。
statement.en:
After the crushing defeat of the Liu Song expeditionary force at Huatai and Luoyang, Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei personally led a large army south, attacking the Liu Song's Jiangbei region. The Wei forces captured Xuanhu, Xiangcheng, and other towns, reaching Guabu (modern Luhe, Nanjing), threatening Jiankang across the river. The Wei army committed large-scale massacres in Jiangbei, causing heavy casualties, and Liu Song's vitality was greatly damaged. The 'Yuanjia Administration' thus came to an end.

For Asia in 450 CE, “Liu Song's Yuanjia northern expedition ends in disaster; Jiangbei region savagely ravaged” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 爱尔兰僧侣远航发现冰岛

summary.zh: 爱尔兰的基督教僧侣狄库伊尔在其著作《论土地测量》中记载，一些爱尔兰僧侣乘船向北航行，发现了一个名为“图勒”的岛屿（被认为是冰岛）。这些僧侣在岛上居住了几个月，发现岛上没有夏季黑夜，但冬季被冰雪覆盖。这是欧洲人最早发现冰岛的记录。

title.zh: 北魏太武帝率军南征，到达瓜步，威胁建康

summary.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘率大军南征，从淮水渡过长江，抵达瓜步（今南京六合），隔江与刘宋都城建康相望。宋文帝刘义隆下令建康戒严，百姓惊恐。因缺乏渡船和天气炎热，北魏军队撤军北返。太武帝在撤退途中洗劫了江北六州，刘宋国力遭到毁灭性打击。

statement.en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei led his army south, crossing the Huai River and reaching Guabu (modern Luhe, Nanjing), facing the Liu Song capital Jiankang across the Yangtze.

en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei led his army south, crossing the Huai River and reaching Guabu (modern Luhe, Nanjing), facing the Liu Song capital Jiankang across the Yangtze.

title.zh: 卡尔西顿公会议：二性论成为正统

summary.zh: 451年，马尔西安在卡尔西顿召集第四次大公会议，约520名主教或代表出席；会议确认基督神人二性，拒绝一性论，并发布纪律法令、设立牧首区。

statement.zh: 451年，马尔西安在卡尔西顿（今土耳其卡德柯伊）召集第四次基督教大公会议。约520名主教或他们的代表出席；这是早期大公会议中规模最大、记录最完整的一次。
statement.en: In 451, Emperor Marcian convoked the fourth ecumenical council at Chalcedon, modern Kadıköy in Turkey. About 520 bishops or their representatives attended; it was the largest and best-documented of the early councils.

sources.excerpt: Council of Chalcedon, fourth ecumenical council of the Christian church, held in Chalcedon (modern Kadiköy, Turkey) in 451. Convoked by the emperor Marcian, it was attended by about 520 bishops or their representatives and was the largest and best-documented of the early councils.

zh: 451年，马尔西安在卡尔西顿（今土耳其卡德柯伊）召集第四次基督教大公会议。约520名主教或他们的代表出席；这是早期大公会议中规模最大、记录最完整的一次。
en: In 451, Emperor Marcian convoked the fourth ecumenical council at Chalcedon, modern Kadıköy in Turkey. About 520 bishops or their representatives attended; it was the largest and best-documented of the early councils.

note.zh: 原文拼写 Kadiköy；正文用土耳其语常见写法 Kadıköy。
note.en: The source spells Kadiköy; the body uses the common Turkish spelling Kadıköy.

statement.zh: 会议批准尼西亚信经、君士坦丁堡信经、西里尔反对聂斯脱里的两封书信，以及教皇利奥一世的《大卷》。它确认基督具有神、人两种本性，拒绝“基督只有一性”的一性论。
statement.en: The council approved the creed of Nicaea, the creed of Constantinople, two letters of Cyril of Alexandria against Nestorius, and Leo I's Tome. It confirmed two distinct natures in Christ and rejected the monophysite doctrine of one nature.

sources.excerpt: It approved the creed of Nicaea (325), the creed of Constantinople (381; subsequently known as the Nicene Creed), two letters of St. Cyril of Alexandria against Nestorius, which insisted on the unity of divine and human persons in Christ, and the Tome of Pope Leo I confirming two distinct natures in Christ and rejecting the monophysite doctrine that Christ had only one nature.

zh: 会议批准尼西亚信经、君士坦丁堡信经、西里尔反对聂斯脱里的两封书信，以及教皇利奥一世的《大卷》。它确认基督具有神、人两种本性，拒绝“基督只有一性”的一性论。
en: The council approved the creed of Nicaea, the creed of Constantinople, two letters of Cyril of Alexandria against Nestorius, and Leo I's Tome. It confirmed two distinct natures in Christ and rejected the monophysite doctrine of one nature.

note.zh: 不写“调和亚历山大派与安提阿派”；会议实际作出了排他性定义。
note.en: No claim of reconciling Alexandria and Antioch; the council made an exclusionary definition.

statement.zh: 会议的信条说，基督“在神性上完美，在人性上完美……具有二性，不相混合、不改变、不分割、不分离”。
statement.en: Its formula spoke of Christ as perfect in deity and perfect in humanity, "in two natures, without being mixed, transmuted, divided, or separated."

sources.locator: Britannica Q&A: Christology — Council of Chalcedon
sources.excerpt: The Council of Chalcedon in 451 stated that Jesus Christ is "perfect in deity and perfect in humanity...in two natures, without being mixed, transmuted, divided, or separated".

zh: 会议的信条说，基督“在神性上完美，在人性上完美……具有二性，不相混合、不改变、不分割、不分离”。
en: Its formula spoke of Christ as perfect in deity and perfect in humanity, "in two natures, without being mixed, transmuted, divided, or separated."

note.zh: 引文按原文；中文“不改变”对应 transmuted，不是“不可改变”。
note.en: Quotation follows the source; 'transmuted' is rendered as '不改变' rather than 'immutable'.

statement.zh: 会议还发布涉及修士与神职人员的纪律法令，并把耶路撒冷和君士坦丁堡列为牧首区，使教会拥有更稳定的制度结构。
statement.en: The council also issued disciplinary decrees for monks and clergy and declared Jerusalem and Constantinople patriarchates, giving the church a more stable institutional character.

sources.excerpt: Besides reinforcing canons of earlier church councils as well as declarations of some local synods, the council issued disciplinary decrees affecting monks and clergy and declared Jerusalem and Constantinople patriarchates. The overall effect was to give the church a more stable institutional character.

zh: 会议还发布涉及修士与神职人员的纪律法令，并把耶路撒冷和君士坦丁堡列为牧首区，使教会拥有更稳定的制度结构。
en: The council also issued disciplinary decrees for monks and clergy and declared Jerusalem and Constantinople patriarchates, giving the church a more stable institutional character.

note.zh: “牧首区”对应 patriarchates；不写“五个牧首区体系由此完成”。
note.en: 'Patriarchates' follows the source; no claim that the five-patriarch system was completed here.

statement.zh: 定义正统也是划界：拒绝一性论，意味着帝国东部的一部分基督徒被留在正统之外，围绕卡尔西顿的争议此后长期存在。
statement.en: Defining orthodoxy was also drawing a line: the rejection of monophysitism left part of the eastern Christian world outside the settlement, and the dispute over Chalcedon endured.

zh: 定义正统也是划界：拒绝一性论，意味着帝国东部的一部分基督徒被留在正统之外，围绕卡尔西顿的争议此后长期存在。
en: Defining orthodoxy was also drawing a line: the rejection of monophysitism left part of the eastern Christian world outside the settlement, and the dispute over Chalcedon endured.

note.zh: 后果分析，不写具体教会分裂年份与教派清单。
note.en: Analysis of consequences; no specific schism dates or denominational list.

title.zh: 北魏太武帝被宦官宗爱杀害，文成帝继位

summary.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘因宠爱宦官宗爱，导致宗爱权势熏天。太武帝发现宗爱陷害太子拓跋晃后想处死宗爱，宗爱先下手为强，派人暗杀太武帝，终年四十五岁。宗爱随后立太武帝幼子拓跋翰为帝，又将其杀害，最后立太武帝长孙拓跋濬为帝，是为文成帝。文成帝即位后处死宗爱，并开始恢复佛教。

statement.zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘因宠爱宦官宗爱，导致宗爱权势熏天。太武帝发现宗爱陷害太子拓跋晃后想处死宗爱，宗爱先下手为强，派人暗杀太武帝，终年45岁。宗爱随后立太武帝幼子拓跋翰为帝，又将其杀害，最后立太武帝长孙拓跋濬为帝，是为文成帝。文成帝即位后处死宗爱，并开始恢复佛教。
statement.en:
Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei's favor for the eunuch Zong Ai allowed the latter to become extremely powerful. When Taiwu discovered that Zong Ai had framed the crown prince Tuoba Huang and sought to execute Zong Ai, Zong Ai struck first, having Taiwu assassinated at age 45. Zong Ai then installed Taiwu's youngest son Tuoba Han as emperor, but then killed him as well, finally establishing Taiwu's grandson Tuoba Jun as emperor, known as Emperor Wencheng. After ascending, Wencheng executed Zong Ai and began to restore Buddhism.

For Asia in 452 CE, “Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei murdered by eunuch Zong Ai; Emperor Wencheng ascends” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘因宠爱宦官宗爱，导致宗爱权势熏天。太武帝发现宗爱陷害太子拓跋晃后想处死宗爱，宗爱先下手为强，派人暗杀太武帝，终年45岁。宗爱随后立太武帝幼子拓跋翰为帝，又将其杀害，最后立太武帝长孙拓跋濬为帝，是为文成帝。文成帝即位后处死宗爱，并开始恢复佛教。

en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei's favor for the eunuch Zong Ai allowed the latter to become extremely powerful. When Taiwu discovered that Zong Ai had framed the crown prince Tuoba Huang and sought to execute Zong Ai, Zong Ai struck first, having Taiwu assassinated at age 45. Zong Ai then installed Taiwu's youngest son Tuoba Han as emperor, but then killed him as well, finally establishing Taiwu's grandson Tuoba Jun as emperor, known as Emperor Wencheng. After ascending, Wencheng executed Zong Ai and began to restore Buddhism.

title.zh: 刘宋太子刘劭与文帝矛盾激化，政局动荡

summary.zh: 宋文帝刘义隆与太子刘劭因巫蛊事件产生严重矛盾。刘劭勾结女巫严道育，用巫蛊诅咒文帝早死。事情败露后，文帝拟废太子，刘劭抢先发动政变，杀害文帝。刘劭自立为帝，但遭到宗室和朝臣的反对，南朝宋陷入内乱。

statement.en:
Emperor Wen of Song had a serious conflict with his crown prince Liu Shao over witchcraft. Liu Shao colluded with the sorceress Yan Daoyu to curse the emperor to an early death. When the plot was discovered, the emperor planned to depose the prince. Liu Shao launched a preemptive coup, killing Emperor Wen. Liu Shao proclaimed himself emperor, but faced opposition from imperial clansmen and officials, plunging Liu Song into civil war.

title.zh: 刘骏镇压竟陵王刘诞叛乱

summary.zh: 宋孝武帝刘骏的弟弟竟陵王刘诞坐镇广陵（今江苏扬州），意图谋反。刘骏派大军围攻广陵，城破后刘诞被处死。刘骏借机大肆诛杀宗室和功臣，刘宋宗室力量进一步削弱。

statement.zh: 宋孝武帝刘骏的弟弟竟陵王刘诞坐镇广陵（今江苏扬州），意图谋反。刘骏派大军围攻广陵，城破后刘诞被处死。刘骏借机大肆诛杀宗室和功臣，刘宋宗室力量进一步削弱。
statement.en:
The Prince of Jingling, Liu Dan (brother of Emperor Xiaowu of Song), based at Guangling (modern Yangzhou, Jiangsu), plotted rebellion. Xiaowu sent a large force to besiege Guangling. After the city fell, Liu Dan was executed. Xiaowu took the opportunity to massacre many imperial clansmen and meritorious officials, further weakening the Liu Song imperial house.

For Asia in 455 CE, “Emperor Xiaowu of Song suppresses rebellion of Prince of Jingling, Liu Dan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 西罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世被杀，帝国名存实亡

summary.zh: 西罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世在罗马城被埃提乌斯的旧部杀死，终年三十五岁。东罗马皇帝马尔西安拒绝承认瓦伦提尼安的儿子继位，另立佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯为帝。马克西穆斯在位仅七十七天，汪达尔军队攻陷罗马时被民众打死。此后西罗马帝国皇位频繁更迭，实际权力落入蛮族将领手中，名存实亡。

statement.zh: 西罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世在罗马城被埃提乌斯的旧部杀死，终年35岁。东罗马皇帝马尔西安拒绝承认瓦伦提尼安的儿子继位，另立佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯为帝。马克西穆斯在位仅七十七天，汪达尔军队攻陷罗马时被民众打死。此后西罗马帝国皇位频繁更迭，实际权力落入蛮族将领手中，名存实亡。
statement.en:
Valentinian III was killed in Rome by followers of the late Aetius, at age 35. Eastern Roman Emperor Marcian refused to recognize Valentinian's son as successor and instead installed Petronius Maximus as emperor. Maximus reigned only 77 days before being killed by the populace when the Vandals sacked Rome. Thereafter, the Western Roman throne frequently changed hands; real power fell into the hands of barbarian generals, and the empire existed only in name.

For Europe in 455 CE, “Western Roman Emperor Valentinian III killed; empire in name only” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 汪达尔军队洗劫罗马城，带走皇室财宝

summary.zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克应西罗马皇后欧多克西娅之邀率军攻陷罗马城，在城中洗劫十四天。汪达尔人抢走了罗马元老院的黄金、朱庇特神庙的珍宝、犹太教圣殿的金灯台（公元70年提图斯从耶路撒冷带回的战利品）。罗马城遭到比410年更严重的破坏。

title.zh: 北魏文成帝下诏恢复佛教，云冈石窟开凿

summary.zh: 北魏文成帝拓跋濬下诏恢复佛教，解除太武帝时期的灭佛令。文成帝命僧人昙曜在平城（今山西大同）西郊的武周山开凿云冈石窟。昙曜主持开凿了昙曜五窟（第16-20窟），雕刻了巨大的佛像，象征北魏的五位皇帝。云冈石窟的开凿标志着北方佛教复兴的开始。

statement.zh: 北魏文成帝拓跋濬下诏恢复佛教，解除太武帝时期的灭佛令。文成帝命僧人昙曜在平城（今山西大同）西郊的武周山开凿云冈石窟。昙曜主持开凿了昙曜5窟（第16-20窟），雕刻了巨大的佛像，象征北魏的5位皇帝。云冈石窟的开凿标志着北方佛教复兴的开始。
statement.en:
Emperor Wencheng of Northern Wei issued an edict to restore Buddhism, ending the persecution of Buddhism that began under Emperor Taiwu. He ordered the monk Tan Yao to carve the Yungang Grottoes at Mount Wuzhou west of Pingcheng (modern Datong, Shanxi). Tan Yao oversaw the excavation of the '5 Caves of Tan Yao' (Caves 16–20), carving colossal Buddha figures symbolizing the five Northern Wei emperors. The excavation of the Yungang Grottoes marked the beginning of the revival of Buddhism in the north.

For Asia in 458 CE, “Emperor Wencheng of Northern Wei restores Buddhism; excavation of Yungang Grottoes begins” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 刘宋浙东地区（今浙江东部）因赋税沉重爆发农民起义，义军领袖自称皇帝，聚众数万。宋孝武帝刘骏派老将沈庆之率军镇压，经过数月激战，起义失败。沈庆之屠杀了数万义军，浙东民怨更加沸腾。

statement.en:
In the eastern Zhejiang region of Liu Song, heavy taxation led to a peasant rebellion. The rebel leader proclaimed himself emperor and gathered 10,000 of followers. Emperor Xiaowu sent the veteran general Shen Qingzhi to suppress the rebellion. After months of fighting, the rebellion failed. Shen Qingzhi had 10,000 of rebels killed, increasing popular resentment in eastern Zhejiang.

title.zh: 沈庆之再次平定竟陵王刘诞叛乱

summary.zh: 宋孝武帝刘骏的弟弟竟陵王刘诞在广陵（今江苏扬州）正式起兵反叛。刘骏派沈庆之率大军围攻广陵，沈庆之采用挖地道、火攻等方式，经过数月才攻破坚城。刘诞被斩，刘骏下令屠城，杀尽城中男子。刘宋宗室内斗愈演愈烈。

statement.zh: 宋孝武帝刘骏的弟弟竟陵王刘诞在广陵（今江苏扬州）正式起兵反叛。刘骏派沈庆之率大军围攻广陵，沈庆之采用挖地道、火攻等方式，经过数月才攻破坚城。刘诞被斩，刘骏下令屠城，杀尽城中男子。刘宋宗室内斗愈演愈烈。
statement.en:
The Prince of Jingling, Liu Dan (brother of Emperor Xiaowu), formally rebelled at Guangling (modern Yangzhou, Jiangsu). Xiaowu sent Shen Qingzhi with a large force to besiege Guangling. Shen used tunneling, fire attacks, and other tactics, and finally captured the city after months. Liu Dan was executed, and Xiaowu ordered a massacre, killing all adult males in the city. Liu Song intra-clan fighting became even more brutal.

For Asia in 459 CE, “Shen Qingzhi again suppresses rebellion of Prince of Jingling, Liu Dan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 云冈石窟大规模开凿，成为中国北方佛教艺术中心

summary.zh: 北魏文成帝命僧人昙曜在平城武周山继续大规模开凿云冈石窟。云冈石窟的佛像融合了犍陀罗艺术和北魏鲜卑文化，体量巨大，风格雄浑。中期的石窟（第5-13窟）出现了双层窟、中心塔柱等建筑形式，佛龛中出现了“二佛并坐”和维摩诘像，体现了北魏佛教的繁荣。云冈石窟是中原北方最早的大型石窟群，对龙门石窟、敦煌石窟等产生了深远影响。

summary.zh: 源于波斯和中亚的梨形弹拨乐器琵琶，经由丝绸之路、通过西域传入中国中原地区。琵琶的音箱呈梨形，颈与面板上设有音位，有四条弦，用拨子或手指弹奏。琵琶很快受到中原宫廷和民间的欢迎，北朝的石窟壁画中大量出现琵琶演奏的场景。唐代诗人白居易的《琵琶行》使琵琶成为中国最富表现力的民族乐器之一。琵琶的传入是丝绸之路文化交流的典型例证。

statement.en:
The pear-shaped plucked lute known as the pipa, originating in Persia and Central Asia, was introduced into central China via the Silk Road through the Western Regions. The pipa's resonating body is pear-shaped, with frets on the neck and fingerboard, four strings, and is played with a plectrum or fingers. It quickly gained popularity in central Chinese courts and among commoners. The pipa appears extensively in Northern Dynasties cave paintings. The Tang dynasty poet Bai Juyi's 'Song of the Pipa' made it one of China's most expressive national instruments. The pipa's introduction is a classic example of cultural exchange along the Silk Road.

For Asia in 460 CE, “Pipa enters central China via the Silk Road” is a traceable node of Music change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 刘宋祖冲之编制《大明历》，精确推算回归年

summary.zh: 刘宋科学家祖冲之编制了《大明历》，测定回归年长度为365.24281481日，与现代测量值仅差46秒；计算交点月为27.21223日，与今值极为接近。《大明历》首次引入了岁差，并改进了闰法，将19年7闰改为391年144闰，是当时世界上最先进的历法。但由于宋孝武帝宠臣戴法兴的反对，《大明历》直到祖冲之去世后才得以推行。

statement.zh: 刘宋科学家祖冲之编制了《大明历》，测定回归年长度为365.24281481日，与现代测量值仅差46秒；计算交点月为27.21223日，与今值极为接近。《大明历》首次引入了岁差，并改进了闰法，将19年7闰改为391年144闰，是当时世界上最先进的历法。但由于宋孝武帝宠臣戴法兴的反对，《大明历》直到祖冲之去世后才得以推行。
statement.en:
The Liu Song scientist Zu Chongzhi compiled the Daming Calendar. He determined the tropical year length as 365.24281481 days, only 46 seconds off modern measurements, and the draconic month as 27.21223 days, very close to today's value. The Daming Calendar introduced precession for the first time and improved intercalation, changing from 19 years with 7 intercalary months to 391 years with 144 intercalary months. It was the most advanced calendar of its time. However, due to opposition from Emperor Xiaowu's favorite courtier Dai Faxing, the Daming Calendar was not implemented until after Zu's death.

For Asia in 462 CE, “Zu Chongzhi of Liu Song compiles the Daming Calendar, accurately calculates tropical year” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 宋孝武帝刘骏病逝，前废帝刘子业继位

summary.zh: 宋孝武帝刘骏在建康病逝，太子刘子业继位，是为宋前废帝，年仅十六岁。刘子业生性残暴，胡作非为，猜忌宗室和大臣，引发了刘宋内部的全面动荡。他的暴政加速了刘宋的灭亡。

statement.zh: 宋孝武帝刘骏在建康病逝，太子刘子业继位，是为宋前废帝，年仅十六岁。刘子业生性残暴，胡作非为，猜忌宗室和大臣，引发了刘宋内部的全面动荡。他的暴政加速了刘宋的灭亡。
statement.en:
Emperor Xiaowu of Song died of illness in Jiankang. His crown prince Liu Ziye ascended the throne, known as Emperor Qianfei of Song (or Former Deposed Emperor), at age sixteen. Liu Ziye was cruel and dissolute, engaging in egregious behavior, and suspicious of imperial clansmen and ministers, triggering total turmoil within Liu Song. His tyranny accelerated the dynasty's downfall.

For Asia in 463 CE, “Emperor Xiaowu of Song dies; Emperor Qianfei of Song (Liu Ziye) ascends” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 东罗马皇帝利奥一世任命伊苏里亚人芝诺为女婿，缓和内政

summary.zh: 东罗马皇帝利奥一世为了争取伊利里亚军区将领的支持，将女儿阿里阿德涅嫁给伊苏里亚人芝诺。芝诺出身于东部边境的部族首领家庭，这一联姻加强了利奥一世的统治基础，但也为后来的芝诺登基埋下伏笔。

statement.zh: 东罗马皇帝利奥一世为了争取伊利里亚军区将领的支持，将女儿阿里阿德涅嫁给伊苏里亚人芝诺。芝诺出身于东部边境的部族首领家庭，这一联姻加强了利奥一世的统治基础，但也为后来的芝诺登基埋下伏笔。
statement.en:
To gain the support of the military command in Illyria, Leo I married his daughter Ariadne to Zeno, an Isaurian. Zeno came from a chieftain family on the eastern frontier. This marriage strengthened Leo's ruling base but also set the stage for Zeno's later accession.

For Europe in 464 CE, “Eastern Roman Emperor Leo I marries his daughter to Isaurian Zeno to ease internal politics” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 东哥特人进入意大利，受命于西罗马皇帝

summary.zh: 东哥特国王提奥多里克大帝（当时还是王子）率东哥特军队进入意大利，名义上是应东罗马皇帝芝诺的要求，帮助西罗马帝国平定意大利的日耳曼雇佣军首领奥多亚塞。提奥多里克实际上意图征服意大利，建立东哥特王国。

statement.en: The Ostrogothic king Theodoric the Great (then still a prince) led the Ostrogothic army into Italy, nominally at the request of Eastern Roman Emperor Zeno to help the Western Roman Empire deal with the barbarian mercenary leader Odoacer in Italy.
